# Sheen full component context

Generated from sheen.manifest.json. Do not edit by hand.

## @gemologic/sheen-charts

### AreaChart

Renders bounded SVG area series with honest NaN gaps and optional positive/negative stacking.

Category: data

Props:
- `curve: "linear"|"step"` (optional; default "linear"). Honest linear or step-after interpolation.
- `stacked: boolean` (optional; default false). Stacks positive and negative values independently.
- `label: string` (required). Required visible and accessible chart name.
- `summary: string` (required). Required narrative interpretation.
- `xLabel: string` (required). Required domain-axis and native-table label.
- `series: readonly ChartSeries[]` (required). Validated series definitions with semantic colors and optional non-color line encodings.
- `data: ChartData` (required). Equal-length Float64 columns; NaN terminates line and fill.
- `x: ChartTimeAxis|ChartNumberAxis` (required). Time or numeric domain formatting.
- `y: ChartValueAxis` (optional). Shared value formatting and optional zero baseline.
- `height: number` (required). Reserved SVG height, at least 120 CSS pixels.
- `legend: ChartLegend` (optional; default "inline"). Inline, stacked, or hidden series key.
- `tooltip: boolean` (optional; default true). Whether single-tab-stop pointer and keyboard inspection is enabled.
- `annotations: readonly ChartAnnotation[]` (optional). Optional labeled domain positions.
- `empty: JSX.Element` (optional). Optional empty-state content.
- `loading: boolean` (optional; default false). Marks retained accepted content busy.
- `table: ChartTableOptions` (optional). Native-table disclosure label and bounded page size.
- `class: string` (optional). Optional class appended to the figure.

Accessibility role: labeled SVG image with visible narrative and native table disclosure
Keyboard: Focus the plot and use Left/Right, Home/End, and Escape to inspect samples., Use the native view-as-table disclosure for every exact sample.
Tokens: `--sheen-chart-1`, `--sheen-chart-2`, `--sheen-chart-grid`, `--sheen-chart-axis`, `--sheen-chart-line-width`, `--sheen-color-fg`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`

Do:
- Use stacking only when totals and component contribution are meaningful.

Do not:
- Do not interpolate or fill across NaN gaps.

Example, Traffic volume:
```tsx
const trafficSeries = defineSeries([{ key: 'read', label: 'Reads', color: 'chart-1' }, { key: 'write', label: 'Writes', color: 'chart-2' }]);
const trafficData = { t: new Float64Array([1, 2, 3]), read: new Float64Array([20, 24, 22]), write: new Float64Array([8, Number.NaN, 12]) };
<AreaChart label="Traffic" summary="Reads remain above writes; one write sample is missing." xLabel="Interval" series={trafficSeries} data={trafficData} x={{ type: "number" }} height={240} stacked />
```

### BarChart

Renders bounded grouped or stacked categorical bars in vertical or horizontal responsive SVG layouts.

Category: data

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required visible and accessible chart name.
- `summary: string` (required). Required narrative interpretation.
- `categoryLabel: string` (required). Required label for the categorical axis and table column.
- `valueLabel: string` (required). Required label for the quantitative axis.
- `series: readonly ChartSeries[]` (required). Validated series definitions and semantic colors.
- `data: ChartCategoricalData` (required). Unique category labels plus equal-length Float64 value columns.
- `y: ChartValueAxis` (optional). Value formatting; bars always retain an honest zero baseline.
- `height: number` (required). Reserved SVG height, at least 160 CSS pixels.
- `legend: ChartLegend` (optional; default "inline"). Inline, stacked, or hidden series key.
- `tooltip: boolean` (optional; default true). Whether single-tab-stop pointer and keyboard category inspection is enabled.
- `empty: JSX.Element` (optional). Optional empty-state content.
- `loading: boolean` (optional; default false). Marks retained accepted content busy.
- `table: ChartTableOptions` (optional). Native-table disclosure label and bounded page size.
- `class: string` (optional). Optional class appended to the figure.
- `layout: "vertical"|"horizontal"` (optional; default "vertical"). Vertical columns or horizontal bars.
- `arrangement: "stacked"|"grouped"` (optional; default "grouped"). Bars grouped beside each other or stacked by sign.

Accessibility role: labeled SVG image with visible narrative and native categorical table disclosure
Keyboard: Focus the plot and use Left/Right, Home/End, and Escape to inspect categories., Use the native view-as-table disclosure for every exact category and value.
Tokens: `--sheen-chart-1`, `--sheen-chart-2`, `--sheen-chart-grid`, `--sheen-chart-axis`, `--sheen-color-fg`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`

Do:
- Use unique explicit category labels and preserve missing bars as NaN.

Do not:
- Do not truncate the quantitative axis away from zero or exceed 2,000 SVG marks.

Example, Revenue by region:
```tsx
const revenueSeries = defineSeries([{ key: 'current', label: 'Current', color: 'chart-1' }, { key: 'previous', label: 'Previous', color: 'chart-3' }]);
const revenueData = { categories: ['North', 'South', 'West'], values: { current: new Float64Array([42, 36, 51]), previous: new Float64Array([38, Number.NaN, 46]) } };
<BarChart label="Regional revenue" summary="West leads; South lacks a prior-period value." categoryLabel="Region" valueLabel="Revenue" series={revenueSeries} data={revenueData} y={{ format: "number" }} height={260} arrangement="grouped" />
```

### ChartDataTable

Provides a bounded, localized native-table alternative and narrative summary for a chart.

Category: data

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required accessible table caption naming the chart data.
- `summary: string` (required). Required narrative description shown when the table disclosure opens.
- `xLabel: string` (required). Required header for the time or numeric domain column.
- `series: readonly ChartSeries[]` (required). Validated series definitions used as column headers.
- `data: ChartData` (required). Validated equal-length Float64 columns; NaN cells remain explicit gaps.
- `x: ChartTimeAxis|ChartNumberAxis` (required). Time or numeric domain formatting; omitted timezones deterministically use UTC.
- `y: ChartValueAxis` (optional). Shared value formatting for every series column.
- `pageSize: number` (optional; default 50). Rows mounted per table page, from 1 through 200.
- `viewLabel: string` (optional). Optional localized disclosure label; context messages supply the default.
- `loading: boolean` (optional; default false). Marks the retained accepted table busy without replacing its rows.
- `class: string` (optional). Optional class appended to the disclosure root.

Accessibility role: native details disclosure containing a captioned table
Keyboard: Enter or Space toggles the native summary., Pagination uses native button order.
Tokens: `--sheen-color-fg`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`, `--sheen-color-border`, `--sheen-color-bg-subtle`

Do:
- Give every chart a concise narrative summary and preserve gaps as missing values.
- Keep page sizes bounded even though chart data is already in memory.

Do not:
- Do not mount an entire high-volume time series as table rows.
- Do not format dates with the browser's implicit timezone or locale.

Example, Latency data alternative:
```tsx
const latencySeries = defineSeries([{ key: 'p99', label: 'p99 latency', color: 'chart-3' }]);
const latencyData = { t: new Float64Array([1704067200000, 1704067260000]), p99: new Float64Array([42, Number.NaN]) };
<ChartDataTable label="API latency" summary="Latency generally declined; one sample is missing." xLabel="Time" series={latencySeries} data={latencyData} x={{ type: "time", tz: "UTC" }} y={{ format: "duration" }} />
```

### LineChart

Renders a responsive token-themed SVG line chart for bounded time or numeric data with explicit gaps.

Category: data

Props:
- `curve: "linear"|"step"` (optional; default "linear"). Honest linear or step-after interpolation.
- `label: string` (required). Required visible and accessible chart name.
- `summary: string` (required). Required narrative interpretation.
- `xLabel: string` (required). Required domain-axis and native-table label.
- `series: readonly ChartSeries[]` (required). Validated series definitions with semantic colors and optional non-color line encodings.
- `data: ChartData` (required). Equal-length Float64 columns; NaN breaks a path.
- `x: ChartTimeAxis|ChartNumberAxis` (required). Time or numeric domain formatting.
- `y: ChartValueAxis` (optional). Shared value formatting and optional zero baseline.
- `height: number` (required). Reserved SVG height, at least 120 CSS pixels.
- `legend: ChartLegend` (optional; default "inline"). Inline, stacked, or hidden series key.
- `tooltip: boolean` (optional; default true). Whether single-tab-stop pointer and keyboard inspection is enabled.
- `annotations: readonly ChartAnnotation[]` (optional). Optional labeled domain positions.
- `empty: JSX.Element` (optional). Optional empty-state content.
- `loading: boolean` (optional; default false). Marks retained accepted content busy.
- `table: ChartTableOptions` (optional). Native-table disclosure label and bounded page size.
- `class: string` (optional). Optional class appended to the figure.

Accessibility role: labeled SVG image with visible narrative and native table disclosure
Keyboard: Focus the plot and use Left/Right, Home/End, and Escape to inspect samples., Use the native view-as-table disclosure for every exact sample.
Tokens: `--sheen-chart-1`, `--sheen-chart-2`, `--sheen-chart-grid`, `--sheen-chart-axis`, `--sheen-chart-line-width`, `--sheen-color-fg`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`

Do:
- Use for complete bounded data under 2,000 marks and retain NaN gaps.

Do not:
- Do not use SVG for high-volume or streaming time series; use TimeSeries.

Example, Request latency:
```tsx
const requestSeries = defineSeries([{ key: 'p50', label: 'p50', color: 'chart-1' }, { key: 'p99', label: 'p99', color: 'chart-3' }]);
const requestData = { t: new Float64Array([1704067200000, 1704067260000, 1704067320000]), p50: new Float64Array([18, 16, 15]), p99: new Float64Array([42, Number.NaN, 34]) };
<LineChart label="Request latency" summary="Latency declined; one p99 sample is missing." xLabel="Time" series={requestSeries} data={requestData} x={{ type: "time", tz: "UTC" }} y={{ format: "duration" }} height={240} />
```

### Sparkline

Renders a dependency-free inline trend path while preserving NaN gaps.

Category: data

Props:
- `values: Float64Array<ArrayBufferLike>` (required). Float64 values in display order; NaN creates a visible path break.
- `label: string` (required). Required accessible description of the trend.
- `color: ChartColorToken` (optional; default "chart-1"). Semantic chart, market, or accent token name.
- `width: number` (optional; default 120). Positive finite intrinsic and view-box width.
- `height: number` (optional; default 28). Positive finite intrinsic and view-box height.

Accessibility role: img
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-chart-1`, `--sheen-chart-line-width`, `--sheen-color-market-up`, `--sheen-color-market-down`, `--sheen-color-market-flat`, `--sheen-color-accent`

Do:
- Use NaN for missing values and describe the trend in label.

Do not:
- Do not coerce gaps to zero or use a sparkline as the only representation of important data.

Example, Latency trend with a gap:
```tsx
const latency = new Float64Array([18, 16, Number.NaN, 15, 12]);
<Sparkline values={latency} label="Latency over five samples" color="chart-3" />
```

### Stat

Presents one tabular metric with an optional text-labeled directional trend.

Category: data

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required visible metric label.
- `value: string|number` (required). Nonempty display text or a finite number.
- `trend: StatTrend` (optional). Optional directional state; requires trendLabel.
- `trendLabel: string` (optional). Required visible non-color description when trend is supplied.
- `class: string` (optional). Optional class appended to the component root.

Accessibility role: term and definition
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-color-fg`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`, `--sheen-color-market-up`, `--sheen-color-market-down`, `--sheen-color-market-flat`, `--sheen-text-h2-size`

Do:
- State the direction and magnitude in trendLabel.

Do not:
- Do not rely on arrow shape or color to communicate a change.

Example, Directional metric:
```tsx
<Stat label="Error rate" value="0.18%" trend="down" trendLabel="0.04 points lower" />
```

### StatGroup

Groups related tabular metrics under one accessible label.

Category: data

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required accessible label for the related metric set.
- `stats: readonly StatProps[]` (required). One or more stat records rendered with the same validation as Stat.
- `class: string` (optional). Optional class appended to the component root.

Accessibility role: group containing term and definition pairs
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-color-border`, `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-fg`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`

Do:
- Group metrics that users compare together.

Do not:
- Do not put unrelated dashboard values under a vague label.

Example, Service health:
```tsx
import type { StatGroupProps } from "@gemologic/sheen-charts";
const health = [{ label: "Requests", value: "18.2k", trend: "up", trendLabel: "8 percent higher" }, { label: "p99", value: "43 ms", trend: "flat", trendLabel: "unchanged" }] satisfies StatGroupProps["stats"];
<StatGroup label="Service health" stats={health} />
```

### TimeSeries

Progressively enhances a deterministic time-series fallback with a responsive themed uPlot canvas and native data alternative.

Category: data

Props:
- `x: ChartTimeAxis` (required). Time formatting configuration; timezone changes presentation only.
- `cursor: ChartCursorOptions` (optional). Optional named cursor-sync group.
- `onZoom: (range:readonly [number,number]|null)=>void` (optional). Receives the accepted x range after drag zoom and null after reset.
- `__unsafe_uplot: TimeSeriesUPlotOptions` (optional). Explicit typed escape hatch for uPlot options not owned by the Sheen lifecycle.
- `label: string` (required). Required visible and accessible chart name.
- `summary: string` (required). Required narrative interpretation used alongside the visual and table alternative.
- `xLabel: string` (required). Required time-axis label and native table heading.
- `series: readonly ChartSeries[]` (required). Stable validated series definitions with semantic color tokens and optional solid, dashed, dotted, or dash-dot non-color encoding.
- `data: ChartData` (required). Equal-length Float64 columns using UTC epoch milliseconds and NaN gaps.
- `y: ChartValueAxis` (optional). Shared value formatting and optional zero baseline.
- `height: number` (required). Positive finite reserved plot height in CSS pixels.
- `legend: ChartLegend` (optional; default "inline"). Legend presentation; false hides it.
- `tooltip: boolean` (optional; default true). Whether single-tab-stop pointer and keyboard crosshair inspection is enabled.
- `annotations: readonly ChartAnnotation[]` (optional). Optional labeled events at UTC epoch-millisecond positions.
- `empty: JSX.Element` (optional). Optional retained empty-state content for a zero-row dataset.
- `loading: boolean` (optional; default false). Marks accepted chart and table content busy without replacing either.
- `table: ChartTableOptions` (optional). Native table page size and disclosure label; the alternative cannot be disabled.
- `class: string` (optional). Optional class appended to the figure root.

Accessibility role: labeled figure with an image description and native table disclosure
Keyboard: Focus the plot and use Left/Right, Home/End, and Escape to inspect samples., Use the native view-as-table disclosure for complete keyboard access to every sample., Use legend buttons and zoom controls when those interactions are enabled.
Tokens: `--sheen-chart-1`, `--sheen-chart-2`, `--sheen-chart-3`, `--sheen-chart-4`, `--sheen-chart-5`, `--sheen-chart-6`, `--sheen-chart-7`, `--sheen-chart-8`, `--sheen-chart-grid`, `--sheen-chart-axis`, `--sheen-chart-crosshair`, `--sheen-chart-line-width`, `--sheen-color-fg`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`

Do:
- Keep series identities stable and retain accepted data while a refresh is pending.
- Use UTC epoch milliseconds and NaN for gaps, then provide an interpretive summary.
- Use explicit non-color encodings when palette colors repeat or color alone cannot carry the distinction.

Do not:
- Do not hide the native table alternative or pass Date/string timestamps.
- Do not key the chart by data revision, theme, or size.

Example, API latency:
```tsx
const latencySeries = defineSeries([{ key: 'p50', label: 'p50', color: 'chart-1' }, { key: 'p99', label: 'p99', color: 'chart-3' }]);
const latencyData = { t: new Float64Array([1704067200000, 1704067260000, 1704067320000]), p50: new Float64Array([18, 16, 15]), p99: new Float64Array([42, Number.NaN, 34]) };
<TimeSeries label="API latency" summary="Latency declined; one p99 sample is missing." xLabel="Time" series={latencySeries} data={latencyData} x={{ type: "time", tz: "UTC" }} y={{ format: "duration" }} height={220} legend="inline" />
```

## @gemologic/sheen-code

### CodeBlock

Renders accessible source with an optional file header, copy and wrap actions, line emphasis, and serializable Shiki tokens.

Category: content

Props:
- `code: string` (required). Exact source text to render.
- `language: string` (required). Language identifier used for labeling and highlighted-output validation.
- `highlighted: HighlightedCode` (optional). Optional serializable result produced by highlightCode in a loader or build step.
- `highlightedLines: readonly CodeHighlightedLine[]` (optional). One-based line numbers or inclusive ranges to emphasize visually and describe to assistive technology.
- `label: string` (optional). Visible caption and accessible name for the code region.
- `filename: string` (optional). Optional filename rendered in the header and used as the fallback accessible name.
- `lineNumbers: boolean` (optional; default false). Shows non-selectable line numbers.
- `showLanguage: boolean` (optional; default false). Shows the language identifier in the header.
- `copyable: boolean` (optional; default false). Shows an action that copies the exact source through the browser Clipboard API.
- `wrapToggle: boolean` (optional; default false). Shows an accessible control for changing line wrapping.
- `wrapped: boolean` (optional). Controlled wrapping state.
- `defaultWrapped: boolean` (optional; default false). Initial uncontrolled wrapping state.
- `onWrappedChange: (wrapped:boolean)=>void` (optional). Receives a proposed wrapping state in controlled or uncontrolled use.
- `onCopyError: (error:unknown)=>void` (optional). Receives a Clipboard API failure; raw errors are never rendered.

Accessibility role: figure with a focusable preformatted region and optional header actions
Keyboard: Tab focuses copy, wrap, and scroll controls, Enter or Space activates a focused header action
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-border`, `--sheen-color-fg`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`, `--sheen-color-accent`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring-offset`, `--sheen-font-mono`, `--sheen-text-code-size`

Do:
- Precompute highlightCode in a server loader or build step when syntax color is required.
- Pass the exact accepted source to copy and highlight; retain the CodeBlock owner during refresh.

Do not:
- Do not run the highlighter during component render or replace accepted code while refreshing tokens.
- Do not use highlighted lines as the only indication of an error or status.

Example, Copyable TypeScript file:
```tsx
const source = 'const ready: boolean = true;'
<CodeBlock code={source} language="ts" filename="ready.ts" label="Readiness example" lineNumbers showLanguage copyable wrapToggle highlightedLines={[1]} />
```

### DiffViewer

Shows a searchable, copyable unified line diff with bounded computation and virtualized large-content DOM.

Category: content

Props:
- `oldText: string` (required). Complete accepted source before the change.
- `newText: string` (required). Complete accepted source after the change.
- `label: string` (required). Required accessible viewer and line-list name.
- `oldLabel: string` (optional; default "Before"). Label used by the copied unified diff header.
- `newLabel: string` (optional; default "After"). Label used by the copied unified diff header.
- `searchable: boolean` (optional; default true). Shows a debounced line search that does not mutate the source.
- `copyable: boolean` (optional; default true). Copies the complete unified diff.
- `initialHeight: number` (optional; default 360). Deterministic SSR and initial viewport height in pixels from 120 to 1200.
- `lineHeight: number` (optional; default 22). Fixed virtual row height in pixels from 16 to 48.
- `onCopyError: (error:unknown)=>void` (optional). Receives Clipboard API failures without exposing raw errors in the UI.

Accessibility role: named region containing a focusable virtual list and listitems
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, PageUp, PageDown, Home, End
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-danger-subtle`, `--sheen-color-success-subtle`, `--sheen-font-mono`

Do:
- Keep the viewer mounted when accepted source refreshes.
- Use labels that identify both revisions.

Do not:
- Do not rely on red and green alone; prefixes and accessible row labels encode change kind.
- Do not use the viewer as an editable merge tool.

Example, Configuration change:
```tsx
const before = "port = 80\nenabled = false";
const after = "port = 443\nenabled = true";
<DiffViewer oldText={before} newText={after} label="Configuration changes" oldLabel="before.toml" newLabel="after.toml" />
```

### JSONViewer

Validates and deterministically formats JSON into a searchable, copyable, virtualized line view.

Category: content

Props:
- `value: unknown` (required). JSON-compatible value; functions, symbols, bigint, nonfinite numbers, cycles, and excessive depth are rejected.
- `label: string` (required). Required accessible viewer and line-list name.
- `indent: 2|4` (optional; default 2). Pretty-print indentation.
- `sortKeys: boolean` (optional; default true). Sorts object keys for deterministic output.
- `maxDepth: number` (optional; default 32). Maximum accepted nesting depth from 1 to 64.
- `searchable: boolean` (optional; default true). Shows a debounced search over formatted lines.
- `copyable: boolean` (optional; default true). Copies the complete validated JSON string.
- `initialHeight: number` (optional; default 360). Deterministic SSR and initial viewport height in pixels from 120 to 1200.
- `lineHeight: number` (optional; default 22). Fixed virtual row height in pixels from 16 to 48.
- `onCopyError: (error:unknown)=>void` (optional). Receives Clipboard API failures without exposing raw errors in the UI.

Accessibility role: named region containing a focusable virtual list and listitems
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, PageUp, PageDown, Home, End
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-warning-subtle`, `--sheen-font-mono`

Do:
- Pass parsed application data and let JSONViewer validate it.
- Keep sortKeys enabled for copyable diagnostics.

Do not:
- Do not pass secrets or authorization material.
- Do not pass class instances and assume private properties are hidden.

Example, API response:
```tsx
const response = { status: "ready", records: [{ id: "one", amount: 42 }] };
<JSONViewer value={response} label="API response" />
```

### LogViewer

Renders structured logs as a searchable, copyable, virtualized line stream with non-color level labels.

Category: content

Props:
- `entries: readonly LogEntry[]` (required). Accepted structured entries with stable IDs, timestamps, levels, and messages.
- `label: string` (required). Required accessible viewer and line-list name.
- `searchable: boolean` (optional; default true). Shows debounced search over timestamps, levels, messages, and details.
- `copyable: boolean` (optional; default true). Copies the complete plain-text log snapshot.
- `initialHeight: number` (optional; default 360). Deterministic SSR and initial viewport height in pixels from 120 to 1200.
- `lineHeight: number` (optional; default 22). Fixed virtual row height in pixels from 16 to 48.
- `onCopyError: (error:unknown)=>void` (optional). Receives Clipboard API failures without exposing raw errors in the UI.

Accessibility role: named region containing a focusable virtual list and listitems
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, PageUp, PageDown, Home, End
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-warning-fg`, `--sheen-color-danger-fg`, `--sheen-font-mono`

Do:
- Use stable IDs and app-formatted timestamps.
- Replace or append immutable accepted snapshots without remounting the viewer.

Do not:
- Do not put secrets or raw command lines into browser-visible logs.
- Do not use color as the only severity signal.

Example, Deployment logs:
```tsx
import type { LogEntry } from "@gemologic/sheen-code/log-viewer";
const entries = [{ id: "one", timestamp: "2026-09-09T12:00:00Z", level: "info", message: "Deployment started" }] satisfies readonly LogEntry[];
<LogViewer entries={entries} label="Deployment logs" />
```

## @gemologic/sheen-date

### Calendar

An always-visible locale-aware calendar with Ark-backed grid keyboard interaction.

Category: date and time

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required visible calendar label.
- `value: CalendarDate|null` (optional). App-owned Sheen CalendarDate, or null for no selection.
- `defaultValue: CalendarDate|null` (optional). Initial uncontrolled selection.
- `onValueChange: (value:CalendarDate|null)=>void` (optional). Receives requested Sheen-owned selection changes.
- `minValue: CalendarDate` (optional). Earliest selectable calendar date.
- `maxValue: CalendarDate` (optional). Latest selectable calendar date.
- `isDateUnavailable: (value:CalendarDate)=>boolean` (optional). Marks otherwise in-range dates unavailable using Sheen CalendarDate values.
- `defaultVisibleDate: CalendarDate` (optional). Deterministic initially visible month; empty calendars otherwise use 2000-01-01.
- `locale: string` (optional). Explicit BCP 47 locale, defaulting to theme context.
- `calendar: string` (optional). Optional Unicode calendar identifier affecting presentation and interaction, not the stored ISO date.
- `name: string` (optional). Native form field name for the YYYY-MM-DD projection.
- `form: string` (optional). Optional external form owner.
- `required: boolean` (optional; default false). Marks the calendar selection required for accessible semantics.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Prevents focus and selection.
- `readOnly: boolean` (optional; default false). Allows inspection while rejecting selection changes.

Accessibility role: application calendar grid
Keyboard: Arrow keys, PageUp, PageDown, Home, End, Enter, Space
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg`, `--sheen-color-accent`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`

Do:
- Provide defaultVisibleDate for empty SSR output near the application's working date.

Do not:
- Do not derive initial visible dates from the browser clock during hydration.

Example, Deployment date:
```tsx
<Calendar label="Deployment date" name="deploymentDate" defaultValue={createCalendarDate(2026, 9, 8)} defaultVisibleDate={createCalendarDate(2026, 9, 1)} />
```

### DateField

A locale-ordered segmented date editor with an ISO form projection.

Category: date and time

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required visible field label.
- `value: CalendarDate|null` (optional). App-owned Sheen CalendarDate, or null.
- `defaultValue: CalendarDate|null` (optional). Initial uncontrolled value.
- `onValueChange: (value:CalendarDate|null)=>void` (optional). Receives complete valid dates and explicit clearing.
- `placeholderValue: CalendarDate` (optional). Deterministic values shown behind empty segments.
- `minValue: CalendarDate` (optional). Minimum valid date.
- `maxValue: CalendarDate` (optional). Maximum valid date.
- `isDateUnavailable: (value:CalendarDate)=>boolean` (optional). Marks committed dates invalid using Sheen values.
- `locale: string` (optional). Explicit BCP 47 locale, defaulting to theme context.
- `calendar: string` (optional). Optional presentation calendar identifier.
- `name: string` (optional). Native form field name for YYYY-MM-DD.
- `form: string` (optional). Optional external form owner.
- `description: string` (optional). Associated supporting text.
- `error: string` (optional). Associated app validation error.
- `required: boolean` (optional; default false). Marks the segmented editor required.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Disables editing and form projection.
- `readOnly: boolean` (optional; default false). Retains focus while rejecting edits.

Accessibility role: group of spinbuttons
Keyboard: ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, PageUp, PageDown, Home, End, numeric keys
Tokens: `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-color-bg-inset`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`

Do:
- Submit the documented ISO projection instead of reading rendered segments.

Do not:
- Do not pass JavaScript Date objects.

Example, Invoice date:
```tsx
<DateField label="Invoice date" name="invoiceDate" defaultValue={createCalendarDate(2026, 9, 8)} />
```

### DatePicker

A typed date input with a responsive calendar mounted in the nearest theme portal.

Category: date and time

Props:
- `value: CalendarDate|null` (optional). App-owned Sheen CalendarDate, or null.
- `defaultValue: CalendarDate|null` (optional). Initial uncontrolled value.
- `onValueChange: (value:CalendarDate|null)=>void` (optional). Receives complete valid dates and clearing.
- `presets: readonly DatePreset[]` (optional). Deterministic labeled Sheen date shortcuts.
- `label: string` (required). Required visible field label.
- `minValue: CalendarDate` (optional). Earliest selectable date.
- `maxValue: CalendarDate` (optional). Latest selectable date.
- `isDateUnavailable: (value:CalendarDate)=>boolean` (optional). Marks dates unavailable with a Sheen value callback.
- `defaultVisibleDate: CalendarDate` (optional). Deterministic initially visible month.
- `locale: string` (optional). Explicit BCP 47 locale, defaulting to theme context.
- `calendar: string` (optional). Optional presentation calendar identifier.
- `name: string` (optional). Native form name for YYYY-MM-DD.
- `form: string` (optional). Optional external form owner.
- `description: string` (optional). Associated instructions.
- `error: string` (optional). Associated app validation error.
- `placeholder: string` (optional). Text input placeholder.
- `required: boolean` (optional; default false). Marks the picker required.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Disables input, trigger, and projection.
- `readOnly: boolean` (optional; default false). Allows inspection while rejecting changes.

Accessibility role: textbox and calendar dialog
Keyboard: Tab, Enter, Space, Escape, Arrow keys, PageUp, PageDown, Home, End
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`

Do:
- Keep the picker inside ThemeProvider so its overlay inherits the effective scope.

Do not:
- Do not replace accepted content while date constraints refresh.

Example, Settlement date:
```tsx
<DatePicker label="Settlement date" name="settlesAt" defaultValue={createCalendarDate(2026, 9, 10)} defaultVisibleDate={createCalendarDate(2026, 9, 1)} />
```

### DateRangePicker

A two-ended date picker that keeps its incomplete range draft while accepted state refreshes.

Category: date and time

Props:
- `value: DateRange|null` (optional). App-owned ordered Sheen DateRange, or null.
- `defaultValue: DateRange|null` (optional). Initial uncontrolled accepted range.
- `onValueChange: (value:DateRange|null)=>void` (optional). Receives only complete ordered ranges or explicit clearing.
- `presets: readonly DateRangePreset[]` (optional). Deterministic labeled Sheen range shortcuts.
- `endLabel: string` (optional). Accessible label for the second endpoint, defaulting to the range label plus end.
- `label: string` (required). Required visible range label.
- `minValue: CalendarDate` (optional). Earliest selectable endpoint.
- `maxValue: CalendarDate` (optional). Latest selectable endpoint.
- `isDateUnavailable: (value:CalendarDate)=>boolean` (optional). Marks endpoint dates unavailable.
- `defaultVisibleDate: CalendarDate` (optional). Deterministic initially visible month.
- `locale: string` (optional). Explicit BCP 47 locale, defaulting to theme context.
- `calendar: string` (optional). Optional presentation calendar identifier.
- `name: string` (optional). Native form name for the start/end ISO interval.
- `form: string` (optional). Optional external form owner.
- `description: string` (optional). Associated instructions.
- `error: string` (optional). Associated app validation error.
- `placeholder: string` (optional). Empty endpoint placeholder.
- `required: boolean` (optional; default false). Marks both endpoints required.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Disables interaction and projection.
- `readOnly: boolean` (optional; default false). Allows inspection while rejecting changes.

Accessibility role: two textboxes and calendar dialog
Keyboard: Tab, Enter, Space, Escape, Arrow keys, PageUp, PageDown, Home, End
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`

Do:
- Treat a one-ended calendar interaction as a draft, not an accepted range.

Do not:
- Do not infer missing endpoints or submit two unrelated fields.

Example, Report window:
```tsx
<DateRangePicker label="Report window" name="window" defaultValue={createDateRange(createCalendarDate(2026, 9, 1), createCalendarDate(2026, 9, 8))} />
```

### DateTimePicker

A date, wall-time, and IANA-zone editor that resolves instants without hiding DST ambiguity.

Category: date and time

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required visible fieldset legend.
- `value: DateTime|null` (optional). App-owned Sheen DateTime instant, or null.
- `defaultValue: DateTime|null` (optional). Initial uncontrolled instant.
- `onValueChange: (value:DateTime|null)=>void` (optional). Receives exact or explicitly disambiguated instants and clearing.
- `onResolution: (resolution:DateTimeResolution)=>void` (optional). Observes every exact, ambiguous, or nonexistent wall-time resolution.
- `timeZoneOptions: readonly TimeZoneOption[]` (required). Explicit stable IANA zones passed to the zone combobox.
- `timeZonePending: boolean` (optional; default false). Retains accepted zone options while an app-owned refresh is in flight.
- `timeZoneError: string` (optional). Safe app-owned zone request error.
- `onTimeZoneRetry: ()=>void` (optional). Optional app retry action for a failed zone request.
- `defaultTimeZone: TimeZone` (optional). Zone used by an empty draft, defaulting to UTC.
- `defaultDate: CalendarDate` (optional). Deterministic empty date placeholder.
- `defaultTime: Time` (optional). Deterministic empty wall-time placeholder.
- `disambiguation: DateTimeDisambiguation` (optional; default "reject"). Policy for repeated or skipped local times; reject exposes an explicit choice.
- `timeZoneChangeBehavior: TimeZoneChangeBehavior` (optional; default "preserve-instant"). Whether a zone change preserves the accepted instant or reinterprets the wall time.
- `locale: string` (optional). Explicit BCP 47 locale, defaulting to context.
- `calendar: string` (optional). Optional calendar used only for date presentation and interaction.
- `hourCycle: 12|24` (optional). Explicit 12- or 24-hour cycle.
- `granularity: "minute"|"second"` (optional; default "minute"). Smallest wall-time segment.
- `name: string` (optional). Native form name for the ISO instant with bracketed IANA zone.
- `form: string` (optional). Optional external form owner.
- `description: string` (optional). Associated instructions.
- `error: string` (optional). Associated app validation error.
- `dateLabel: string` (optional). Localized label for the date subfield.
- `timeLabel: string` (optional). Localized label for the wall-time subfield.
- `timeZoneLabel: string` (optional). Localized label for the zone subfield.
- `required: boolean` (optional; default false). Marks all subfields required.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Disables all subfields and projection.
- `readOnly: boolean` (optional; default false). Allows inspection while rejecting changes.

Accessibility role: group, textbox, spinbuttons, combobox, alert
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Escape, Arrow keys, PageUp, PageDown, Home, End
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-color-warning-border`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`

Do:
- Keep reject as the default when the app must distinguish repeated or skipped local times.
- Choose zone-change semantics for the application's domain.

Do not:
- Do not silently substitute the browser timezone or accept an ambiguous wall time.

Example, Maintenance start:
```tsx
<DateTimePicker label="Maintenance start" name="startsAt" timeZoneOptions={[{ id: "UTC", label: "UTC" }, { id: "America/New_York", label: "New York" }]} defaultValue={createDateTime(1788897600000, createTimeZone("UTC"))} />
```

### TimeField

A locale-ordered segmented wall-clock editor with a timezone-free ISO projection.

Category: date and time

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required visible field label.
- `value: Time|null` (optional). App-owned Sheen Time, or null.
- `defaultValue: Time|null` (optional). Initial uncontrolled wall time.
- `onValueChange: (value:Time|null)=>void` (optional). Receives complete valid wall times and clearing.
- `placeholderValue: Time` (optional). Deterministic values shown behind empty segments.
- `minValue: Time` (optional). Minimum wall time.
- `maxValue: Time` (optional). Maximum wall time.
- `locale: string` (optional). Explicit BCP 47 locale, defaulting to theme context.
- `hourCycle: 12|24` (optional). Explicit 12- or 24-hour cycle; omission follows the locale.
- `granularity: TimeGranularity` (optional; default "minute"). Smallest editable unit.
- `name: string` (optional). Native form name for HH:mm:ss.SSS.
- `form: string` (optional). Optional external form owner.
- `description: string` (optional). Associated instructions.
- `error: string` (optional). Associated app validation error.
- `required: boolean` (optional; default false). Marks the editor required.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Disables editing and projection.
- `readOnly: boolean` (optional; default false). Retains focus while rejecting edits.

Accessibility role: group of spinbuttons
Keyboard: ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, PageUp, PageDown, Home, End, numeric keys
Tokens: `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-color-bg-inset`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`

Do:
- Keep a wall-clock Time separate from the zone that gives it an instant.

Do not:
- Do not anchor a standalone Time to the browser's current date.

Example, Cutoff time:
```tsx
<TimeField label="Cutoff time" name="cutoff" defaultValue={createTime(16, 30)} />
```

### TimePicker

A contextual list of Sheen wall-clock values with deterministic interval generation.

Category: date and time

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required visible picker label.
- `value: Time|null` (optional). App-owned Sheen Time, or null.
- `defaultValue: Time|null` (optional). Initial uncontrolled selection.
- `onValueChange: (value:Time|null)=>void` (optional). Receives selected Sheen Time values and clearing.
- `options: readonly TimePickerOption[]` (optional). Optional explicit labeled wall times; values must be unique.
- `stepMinutes: number` (optional; default 15). Generated interval from 1 through 720 minutes when options are omitted.
- `locale: string` (optional). Explicit BCP 47 label locale, defaulting to theme context.
- `hourCycle: 12|24` (optional). Explicit generated-label hour cycle.
- `name: string` (optional). Native form name for HH:mm:ss.SSS.
- `form: string` (optional). Optional external form owner.
- `placeholder: string` (optional). Empty-selection text.
- `description: string` (optional). Associated instructions.
- `error: string` (optional). Associated app validation error.
- `required: boolean` (optional; default false). Requires a selection.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Disables interaction and projection.
- `readOnly: boolean` (optional; default false). Allows inspection while rejecting changes.

Accessibility role: button and listbox
Keyboard: Tab, Enter, Space, Arrow keys, Home, End, Escape, Typeahead
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`

Do:
- Use explicit options when availability is not a uniform interval.

Do not:
- Do not treat the selected wall time as an instant without a date and zone.

Example, Review slot:
```tsx
<TimePicker label="Review slot" name="slot" stepMinutes={30} defaultValue={createTime(14, 30)} />
```

### TimeZoneSelect

An app-bounded IANA timezone combobox with stable SSR and hydration options.

Category: date and time

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required visible combobox label.
- `options: readonly TimeZoneOption[]` (required). Explicit stable IANA IDs and app-localized labels; no host-derived default list.
- `value: TimeZone|null` (optional). App-owned Sheen TimeZone, or null.
- `defaultValue: TimeZone|null` (optional). Initial uncontrolled zone.
- `onValueChange: (value:TimeZone|null)=>void` (optional). Receives validated Sheen TimeZone values and clearing.
- `name: string` (optional). Native form field name for the IANA identifier.
- `form: string` (optional). Optional external form owner.
- `placeholder: string` (optional). Empty-selection text.
- `description: string` (optional). Associated instructions.
- `error: string` (optional). Associated field validation error.
- `pending: boolean` (optional; default false). Retains accepted options while an app-owned refresh is in flight.
- `resultsError: string` (optional). Safe app-owned option request error shown in the open list.
- `onRetry: ()=>void` (optional). Optional app retry action for a failed option request.
- `required: boolean` (optional; default false). Requires a selection.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Disables interaction and projection.
- `readOnly: boolean` (optional; default false). Allows inspection while rejecting changes.

Accessibility role: combobox and listbox
Keyboard: Tab, Arrow keys, Home, End, Enter, Escape, Typeahead
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`

Do:
- Commit one stable option list for server and client rendering.

Do not:
- Do not call Intl.supportedValuesOf during render; ICU lists can differ across hosts.

Example, Market timezone:
```tsx
<TimeZoneSelect label="Market timezone" name="timeZone" options={[{ id: "UTC", label: "UTC" }, { id: "America/New_York", label: "New York" }]} defaultValue={createTimeZone("UTC")} />
```

## @gemologic/sheen-icons

### AddIcon

The statically importable add semantic icon with Radix and Phosphor artwork.

Category: icons

Props:
- `decorative: boolean` (optional; default true). Decorative by default; set false together with a nonempty label for meaningful imagery.
- `label: string` (optional). Required accessible name when decorative is false.
- `size: "sm"|"md"|"lg"` (optional; default "md"). Token-sized icon dimensions.
- `tone: "muted"|"inherit"` (optional; default "muted"). Muted at rest or inherited from an interactive parent.

Accessibility role: img when meaningful; hidden when decorative
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-icon-size-sm`, `--sheen-icon-size-md`, `--sheen-icon-size-lg`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`

Do:
- Use semantic names so themes can switch artwork without changing application code.

Do not:
- Do not place an unlabeled meaningful icon where text is required.

Example, add action:
```tsx
<AddIcon decorative={false} label="add" />
```

The statically importable download semantic icon with Radix and Phosphor artwork.

- `label: string` (optional). Required accessible name when decorative is false.
- `size: "sm"|"md"|"lg"` (optional; default "md"). Token-sized icon dimensions.
- `tone: "muted"|"inherit"` (optional; default "muted"). Muted at rest or inherited from an interactive parent.

Accessibility role: img when meaningful; hidden when decorative
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-icon-size-sm`, `--sheen-icon-size-md`, `--sheen-icon-size-lg`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`

Do:
- Use semantic names so themes can switch artwork without changing application code.

Do not:
- Do not place an unlabeled meaningful icon where text is required.

Example, download action:
```tsx
<DownloadIcon decorative={false} label="download" />
```

### DynamicIcon

An explicit full-registry icon lookup for names that are genuinely known only at runtime.

Category: icons

Props:
- `decorative: boolean` (optional; default true). Decorative by default; set false together with a nonempty label for meaningful imagery.
- `label: string` (optional). Required accessible name when decorative is false.
- `size: "sm"|"md"|"lg"` (optional; default "md"). Token-sized icon dimensions.
- `tone: "muted"|"inherit"` (optional; default "muted"). Muted at rest or inherited from an interactive parent.
- `name: string` (required). Runtime semantic name, validated against the complete registry.

Accessibility role: img when meaningful; hidden when decorative
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-icon-size-sm`, `--sheen-icon-size-md`, `--sheen-icon-size-lg`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`

Do:
- Use only when a literal or per-icon import cannot represent external runtime data.

Do not:
- Do not pay the full-registry bundle cost for a name known in source.

Example, Runtime lookup:
```tsx
<DynamicIcon name="search" decorative={false} label="Search" />
```

### Icon

A statically analyzable semantic icon marker replaced by the Sheen Vite integration.

Category: icons

Props:
- `decorative: boolean` (optional; default true). Decorative by default; set false together with a nonempty label for meaningful imagery.
- `label: string` (optional). Required accessible name when decorative is false.
- `size: "sm"|"md"|"lg"` (optional; default "md"). Token-sized icon dimensions.
- `tone: "muted"|"inherit"` (optional; default "muted"). Muted at rest or inherited from an interactive parent.
- `name: "add"|"remove"|"close"|"check"|"settings"|"search"|"chevronDown"|"chevronUp"|"chevronLeft"|"chevronRight"|"arrowLeft"|"arrowRight"|"arrowUp"|"arrowDown"|"menu"|"moreHorizontal"|"moreVertical"|"filter"|"sortAscending"|"sortDescending"|"refresh"|"download"|"upload"|"edit"|"trash"|"copy"|"externalLink"|"info"|"warning"|"error"|"success"|"calendar"|"clock"|"user"|"users"|"home"|"inbox"|"notifications"|"lock"|"unlock"|"visible"|"hidden"` (required). Literal semantic registry name; dynamic values belong on DynamicIcon.

Accessibility role: img when meaningful; hidden when decorative
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-icon-size-sm`, `--sheen-icon-size-md`, `--sheen-icon-size-lg`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`

Do:
- Configure sheenIcons with every icon set used by bundled themes.

Do not:
- Do not pass computed names; use DynamicIcon when the name is genuinely runtime data.

Example, Literal icon:
```tsx
<Icon name="search" decorative={false} label="Search" />
```
