- `decorative: boolean` (optional; default true). Decorative by default; set false together with a nonempty label for meaningful imagery.
- `label: string` (optional). Required accessible name when decorative is false.
- `size: "sm"|"md"|"lg"` (optional; default "md"). Token-sized icon dimensions.
- `tone: "muted"|"inherit"` (optional; default "muted"). Muted at rest or inherited from an interactive parent.

Accessibility role: img when meaningful; hidden when decorative
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-icon-size-sm`, `--sheen-icon-size-md`, `--sheen-icon-size-lg`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`

Do:
- Use semantic names so themes can switch artwork without changing application code.

Do not:
- Do not place an unlabeled meaningful icon where text is required.

Example, visible action:
```tsx
<VisibleIcon decorative={false} label="visible" />
```

### WarningIcon

The statically importable warning semantic icon with Radix and Phosphor artwork.

Category: icons

Props:
- `decorative: boolean` (optional; default true). Decorative by default; set false together with a nonempty label for meaningful imagery.
- `label: string` (optional). Required accessible name when decorative is false.
- `size: "sm"|"md"|"lg"` (optional; default "md"). Token-sized icon dimensions.
- `tone: "muted"|"inherit"` (optional; default "muted"). Muted at rest or inherited from an interactive parent.

Accessibility role: img when meaningful; hidden when decorative
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-icon-size-sm`, `--sheen-icon-size-md`, `--sheen-icon-size-lg`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`

Do:
- Use semantic names so themes can switch artwork without changing application code.

Do not:
- Do not place an unlabeled meaningful icon where text is required.

Example, warning action:
```tsx
<WarningIcon decorative={false} label="warning" />
```

## @gemologic/sheen-patterns

### AccountMenu

An app-owned account identity and action menu that aligns to its topbar or sidebar placement.

Category: application

Props:
- `account: AdminAccountModel` (required). App-owned identity copy, optional avatar, and Sheen menu items. No authentication or fetching is performed.
- `target: "topbar-end"|"sidebar-header"|"sidebar-footer"` (optional; default "topbar-end"). Semantic chrome target controlling logical dropdown or dropup alignment.
- `collapsed: boolean` (optional; default false). Icon-rail presentation. The composite button retains its explicit accessible name.

Accessibility role: button, menu
Keyboard: Tab, Enter, Space, ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Escape
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-border-control`

Do:
- Clear the model immediately when authorization changes.

Do not:
- Do not put authentication or account transport in the component.

Example, Topbar account:
```tsx
import { ThemeProvider } from "@gemologic/sheen";
<ThemeProvider><AccountMenu account={{ id: "ada", name: "Ada Lovelace", items: [{ kind: "action", id: "sign-out", label: "Sign out", onSelect: () => {} }] }} /></ThemeProvider>
```

### AdminApp

The Sheen application baseline with placement-safe chrome, scoped services, retained content, and responsive details.

Category: application

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Accessible name for the primary content scrolling region.
- `documentTitle: string` (optional). Optional accepted-route document title. Requires an app-owned MetaProvider.
- `preset: AdminPreset` (optional; default "standard"). Named deterministic placement configuration.
- `appearance: AdminAppearance` (optional). Independent semantic chrome, navigation, and action treatments. Exact brand colors use the documented --sheen-admin-color-* aliases.
- `theme: ThemeOverrides` (optional). Optional scoped theme, mode, accent, density, radius, motion, direction, and locale overrides. Omitted axes inherit; density alone defaults to comfortable.
- `placements: readonly AdminPlacementOverride[]` (optional). Per-zone validated overrides. A zone may occur at most once.
- `pathname: string` (required). Accepted app pathname for native navigation matching.
- `router: RouterAdapter` (optional). Optional app-injected navigation and unsaved-change adapter.
- `product: AdminProductModel` (optional). Optional app-owned product identity.
- `workspace: AdminWorkspaceModel` (optional). Optional app-owned workspace selector model.
- `primaryNavigation: AdminNavigationModel` (optional). Optional app-owned primary navigation tree. Links may expose named sibling action menus without nesting controls inside destinations.
- `secondaryNavigation: AdminNavigationModel` (optional). Optional app-owned secondary navigation tree. Links may expose named sibling action menus without changing link semantics.
- `currentView: JSX.Element` (optional). Optional breadcrumb or accepted current-view label.
- `globalSearch: JSX.Element` (optional). Optional app-owned search control. Sheen does not perform the search.
- `actionGroups: readonly AdminActionGroup[]` (optional). Semantic primary, utility, and help action groups with native Button or Link behavior.
- `notifications: AdminNotificationModel` (optional). Optional app-owned notification model.
- `account: AdminAccountModel` (optional). Optional app-owned account identity and menu. Sheen does not authenticate.
- `commandPalette: AdminCommandPaletteModel` (optional). Optional scoped command sources, state, persistence, and error hooks.
- `details: AdminDetailsModel` (optional). Optional controlled or URL-backed details identity and its single content owner.
- `statusBar: JSX.Element` (optional). Optional fixed application status content.
- `refreshing: boolean` (optional; default false). Marks accepted page content busy without replacing or remounting it.
- `contentReady: boolean` (optional). Forwarded route readiness for pane-scroll restoration.
- `sidebarCollapsed: boolean` (optional). Controlled desktop icon-rail state. Phone navigation remains a full drawer.
- `defaultSidebarCollapsed: boolean` (optional; default false). Server-resolved uncontrolled initial icon-rail state.
- `onSidebarCollapsedChange: (collapsed:boolean)=>void` (optional). Collapse proposals from the shell toggle and mod+/ shortcut.
- `sidebarPersistence: AdminSidebarPersistence` (optional). Explicit server-resolved initial preference plus app-owned save and safe error handling. No localStorage read occurs.
- `mobileSidebarOpen: boolean` (optional). Optional app-owned phone drawer state, independent of desktop collapse.
- `onMobileSidebarOpenChange: (open:boolean)=>void` (optional). Phone drawer visibility proposals.
- `shortcutHelp: boolean` (optional; default true). Enable the shared question-mark shortcut sheet and pending shortcut status.
- `development: boolean` (optional; default false). Enable development-only shortcut diagnostics.
- `authorizationKey: string` (optional). Optional diagnostic boundary identity. Apps must clear unauthorized models and content synchronously when it changes.
- `class: string` (optional). Additional class on the low-level AppShell root.
- `children: JSX.Element` (required). Accepted page content. Background refresh keeps this owner mounted.

Accessibility role: banner, navigation, main, complementary, contentinfo, dialog, status
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home, End, Escape, mod+k, mod+/, ?
Tokens: `--sheen-admin-color-canvas`, `--sheen-admin-color-topbar`, `--sheen-admin-color-sidebar`, `--sheen-admin-color-details`, `--sheen-admin-color-status`, `--sheen-admin-color-nav-hover`, `--sheen-admin-color-nav-active`, `--sheen-admin-color-nav-active-fg`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`

Do:
- Treat placements and appearance as stable server input; use themes and accents for global brand axes and admin aliases for shell-specific surfaces.

Do not:
- Do not remount AdminApp during refresh or use it as a global arbitrary-content modal manager.

Example, Standard admin baseline:
```tsx
import { ThemeProvider } from "@gemologic/sheen";
<ThemeProvider><AdminApp label="Operations" pathname="/orders" product={{ name: "Northstar", href: "/" }} primaryNavigation={{ id: "primary", label: "Primary", items: [{ kind: "link", id: "orders", label: "Orders", href: "/orders" }] }}><p>Application content</p></AdminApp></ThemeProvider>
```

### AdminTopbar

A compact, named application control region with deterministic start, center, and end zones.

Category: application

Props:
- `label: string` (optional; default "Application controls"). Accessible region name.
- `start: JSX.Element` (optional). Start-aligned semantic chrome, resolved once.
- `center: JSX.Element` (optional). Center semantic chrome with bounded horizontal overflow.
- `end: JSX.Element` (optional). End-aligned semantic action chrome, resolved once.

Accessibility role: region
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-border`, `--sheen-space-inline-sm`

Do:
- Use AdminApp placement resolution for production shell chrome.

Do not:
- Do not duplicate a semantic control in more than one zone.

Example, Application controls:
```tsx
<AdminTopbar start={<strong>Northstar</strong>} center={<span>Orders</span>} end={<button type="button">Create</button>} />
```

### AppShell

A viewport-constrained application grid with persistent chrome and a native content pane.

Category: application

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required accessible name for the primary content scrolling region.
- `documentTitle: string` (optional). Optional accepted-route document title. Requires an app-owned MetaProvider and never derives copy from a URL.
- `header: JSX.Element` (optional). Fixed top chrome, rendered once in a native header.
- `sidebar: JSX.Element` (optional). Retained sidebar content, projected into desktop aside or phone modal without recreating its owner. Requires ThemeProvider; supply named navigation and constrain internal scrolling.
- `sidebarOpen: boolean` (optional). Controlled desktop sidebar visibility. Rejected proposals leave accepted state unchanged; hiding retains the sidebar DOM and removes it from interaction. Phone state is separate.
- `defaultSidebarOpen: boolean` (optional). Initial uncontrolled desktop visibility, true by default. Uncontrolled phone drawers independently start closed and reset when returning to desktop.
- `onSidebarOpenChange: (open:boolean)=>void` (optional). Proposed sidebar visibility from the shell control or mod+/ binding. Supply sidebarOpen to own acceptance and persistence.
- `sidebarBehavior: "hide"|"collapse"` (optional; default "hide"). Desktop toggle behavior. hide removes the sidebar from layout; collapse retains an interactive icon rail. Phone always uses the independent drawer.
- `mobileSidebarOpen: boolean` (optional). Controlled phone drawer state, independent of desktop sidebarOpen. Uncontrolled phone drawers start closed. Sidebar content requires ThemeProvider.
- `onMobileSidebarOpenChange: (open:boolean)=>void` (optional). Phone drawer visibility proposals from the toggle, shortcut, Escape, or outside press. Apps own controlled acceptance and persistence.
- `statusBar: JSX.Element` (optional). Fixed bottom chrome, rendered once in a native footer.
- `router: RouterAdapter` (optional). Optional app-injected router adapter for dirty navigation blocking. Retry must bypass only this registration once. Requires the shell to be inside ThemeProvider.
- `contentReady: boolean` (optional). Defaults to true. Set false while main-pane route content is incomplete so saved scroll restoration can wait for growth; true settles at the current clamped boundary.
- `shortcutHelp: boolean` (optional). Enable localized help, pending indicator, global question-mark binding, and development-only mod+shift+d theme cycling. Requires app-owned ThemeProvider and ShortcutProvider ancestors; defaults to false. Apps should enable this even when character shortcuts are disabled. Development policy comes from ShortcutProvider.

Accessibility role: main, complementary, banner, contentinfo
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, PageUp, PageDown
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg`, `--sheen-color-border`

Do:
- Load the patterns stylesheet alongside sheen styles.
- Use one shell per document; compare complete shells in separate iframes.

Do not:
- Do not remount the shell during background refresh.
- Do not treat the initial layout as completed router or mobile-drawer integration.

Example, Application frame:
```tsx
import { MetaProvider } from "@solidjs/meta";
<MetaProvider><AppShell label="Workspace" documentTitle="Workspace · Sheen" header={<h1>Workspace</h1>} statusBar={<span>Ready</span>}><p>Application content</p></AppShell></MetaProvider>
```

Example, Shared shortcut help:
```tsx
import { ThemeProvider, ShortcutProvider } from "@gemologic/sheen";
<ThemeProvider><ShortcutProvider development={true}><AppShell label="Workspace" shortcutHelp><p>Application content</p></AppShell></ShortcutProvider></ThemeProvider>
```

### AuthLayout

A deterministic authentication page frame with focused and responsive brand-split presentations.

Category: application

Props:
- `presentation: "focused"|"brand-split"` (optional; default "focused"). Centered focused layout or two-pane brand-split layout. The split mode requires its aside contract.
- `aside: JSX.Element` (optional). Required product context, illustration, or testimonial in brand-split mode.
- `asideLabel: string` (optional). Required accessible name for the brand-split complementary region.
- `asidePosition: AuthLayoutAsidePosition` (optional; default "start"). Logical placement of the brand region in split mode.
- `ref: HTMLElement|((element:HTMLElement)=>void)` (optional). Native main-landmark reference.
- `label: string` (required). Required accessible name for the authentication page's main landmark.
- `brand: JSX.Element` (required). Persistent app-owned product identity displayed above the authentication surface.
- `children: JSX.Element` (required). Authentication controls and status. The application owns providers, requests, errors, redirects, and session state.
- `footer: JSX.Element` (optional). Optional support, privacy, terms, or implementation links below the authentication surface.
- `contentWidth: AuthLayoutContentWidth` (optional; default "md"). Bounded authentication-content width.

Accessibility role: main, complementary, section, heading, footer
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg`, `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-bg-subtle`, `--sheen-color-border`, `--sheen-color-accent-subtle`, `--sheen-space-section`, `--sheen-elevation-raised`

Do:
- Render AuthLayout as the page's single main landmark.
- Keep provider configuration, network requests, errors, redirects, and session state in the application.
- Use complete server-known brand and authentication markup so hydration has one owner.

Do not:
- Do not mount AuthLayout inside AppShell or another main landmark.
- Do not put secrets, authorization codes, or raw identity-provider errors in client markup.
- Do not branch the initial layout on browser width; the split collapse is CSS-only.

Example, Low-level focused frame:
```tsx
import { Button } from "@gemologic/sheen";
<AuthLayout label="Sign in" brand={<strong>Northstar</strong>}><Button variant="solid" tone="accent">Continue with SSO</Button></AuthLayout>
```

### BrandSplitAuthLayout

A branded two-pane authentication starter that collapses to the focused card without replacing content.

Category: application

Props:
- `aside: JSX.Element` (required). Required app-owned product context, illustration, or testimonial. It stays in the DOM and is visually hidden in the narrow focused presentation.
- `asideLabel: string` (required). Required accessible name for the complementary brand region.
- `asidePosition: AuthLayoutAsidePosition` (optional; default "start"). Logical start or end placement of the brand region.
- `ref: HTMLElement|((element:HTMLElement)=>void)` (optional). Native main-landmark reference.
- `brand: JSX.Element` (required). Persistent app-owned product identity above the authentication card.
- `title: string` (required). Required visible page heading and accessible main-landmark name.
- `description: JSX.Element` (optional). Optional provider, organization, or next-step guidance below the heading.
- `children: JSX.Element` (required). App-owned authentication controls and live status.
- `footer: JSX.Element` (optional). Optional support and legal destinations below the card.
- `headingLevel: 1|2|3|4|5|6` (optional; default 1). Semantic heading level for the visible authentication title.
- `contentWidth: AuthLayoutContentWidth` (optional; default "md"). Bounded card width.

Accessibility role: main, complementary, section, heading, footer
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg`, `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-bg-subtle`, `--sheen-color-border`, `--sheen-color-accent-subtle`, `--sheen-space-section`, `--sheen-elevation-raised`

Do:
- Keep the brand region supportive and the authentication action visually dominant.
- Supply a concise aside label and meaningful text alternatives for informative artwork.
- Verify the CSS-only narrow presentation at 200 and 400 percent zoom.

Do not:
- Do not put required authentication instructions only in the brand region because it is hidden on narrow screens.
- Do not autoplay media or animate layout content on mount.
- Do not reorder the form DOM to follow the aside's visual placement.

Example, Product context and SSO:
```tsx
import { Button } from "@gemologic/sheen";
<BrandSplitAuthLayout brand={<strong>Northstar</strong>} title="Sign in" description="Use your work account." asideLabel="Why teams use Northstar" aside={<blockquote>One calm workspace for every operation.</blockquote>}><Button variant="solid" tone="accent">Continue with SSO</Button></BrandSplitAuthLayout>
```

### DataTablePage

Composes page header, app actions, saved-view controls, table-owned query and selection chrome, and explicit regional states.

Category: application

Props:
- `title: string` (required). Visible page title and accessible loading-region label.
- `headingLevel: 1|2|3|4|5|6` (optional; default 1). Semantic heading level for the page title.
- `breadcrumb: JSX.Element` (optional). Optional breadcrumb rendered above the title.
- `headerActions: JSX.Element` (optional). Optional page-level actions beside the title.
- `tabs: JSX.Element` (optional). Optional page tabs below the title row.
- `toolbarLabel: string` (required). Required accessible name for the app-action toolbar.
- `toolbarGroups: readonly ToolbarGroup[]` (optional). Stable app action groups; whole trailing groups overflow together.
- `views: DataTablePageViews` (optional). Controlled app-backed saved-view records, selection, draft name, pending/error state, and operation callbacks.
- `state: DataTablePageState` (optional; default "ready"). Ready content or an authorization-safe not-found, server-error, or permission-denied replacement.
- `loadingPhase: "idle"|"cold"|"refresh"` (optional; default "idle"). Idle, delayed cold fallback, or retained-content refresh presentation.
- `loadingFallback: JSX.Element` (required). Layout-matched cold-load placeholder reserved in server markup.
- `errorTitle: string` (optional). Optional localized title overriding the selected regional error default.
- `errorDescription: string` (optional). Optional localized regional error detail.
- `onRetry: ()=>void|Promise<void>` (optional). Optional regional error retry action.
- `status: JSX.Element` (optional). Optional page status/footer content.
- `children: JSX.Element` (required). The DataTable owner. Its actions prop owns row, context, and selection action behavior.

Accessibility role: region, heading, toolbar, form, alert
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home, End, Enter, Space, Escape
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg`, `--sheen-color-border`, `--sheen-color-danger-fg`, `--sheen-space-block-sm`, `--sheen-space-inline-sm`

Do:
- Keep saved-view persistence and state application in the app adapter.
- Let the child DataTable own search, filters, result counts, columns, and export controls.
- Define DataTable actions once so row context and selection controls cannot drift.
- Use refresh to retain accepted table DOM; use permission-denied to remove unauthorized content immediately.

Do not:
- Do not mirror DataTable query or selection controls into the page toolbar.
- Do not show a cold fallback during background refresh.
- Do not use saved-view records from localStorage as an implicit per-user persistence layer.

Example, Continuous client table page:
```tsx
<DataTablePage title="Accounts" toolbarLabel="Account actions" loadingFallback={<div>Loading accounts</div>}><section aria-label="Accounts table">Accepted table region</section></DataTablePage>
```

### DetailsPanel

One retained detail-content owner with docked, accessible-resizable, and modal Sheet presentations.

Category: application

Props:
- `panelId: string` (required). Stable app or URL-backed identity for the accepted detail record.
- `title: string` (required). Visible panel heading and accessible name.
- `open: boolean` (required). App-owned visibility. Closed content remains mounted and inert while the model exists.
- `presentation: "docked"|"sheet"` (optional; default "docked"). Deterministic docked or Sheet behavior. AdminApp changes this without replacing content.
- `onOpenChange: (open:boolean)=>void` (required). Visibility proposal from close, backdrop, or Escape.
- `returnFocus: ()=>HTMLElement` (optional). Optional surviving focus origin used when closing.
- `resizable: boolean` (optional; default false). Expose a pointer and keyboard separator in docked presentation.
- `width: number` (optional). Controlled width in CSS pixels.
- `defaultWidth: number` (optional; default 360). Initial uncontrolled width in CSS pixels.
- `minWidth: number` (optional; default 280). Minimum accepted width in CSS pixels.
- `maxWidth: number` (optional; default 640). Maximum accepted width in CSS pixels.
- `onWidthChange: (width:number)=>void` (optional). Accepted resize proposal for app persistence or controlled state.
- `closeLabel: string` (optional; default "Close details"). Localized close-control and backdrop label.
- `children: JSX.Element` (required). The single accepted details content owner, never duplicated between presentations.

Accessibility role: complementary, dialog, separator
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Escape, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home, End
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`

Do:
- Keep panelId URL-backed or controlled and pass server-resolved presentation inputs when rendering standalone.

Do not:
- Do not render separate desktop and mobile copies of the content.

Example, Docked inspector:
```tsx
import { ThemeProvider } from "@gemologic/sheen";
<ThemeProvider><DetailsPanel panelId="order-42" title="Order 42" open onOpenChange={() => {}} resizable><p>Accepted detail</p></DetailsPanel></ThemeProvider>
```

### ErrorState

A regional error presentation with app-owned retry and safe rejection feedback.

Category: application

Props:
- `kind: "not-found"|"server"|"permission-denied"` (optional). Not-found, server, or permission-denied presentation; defaults to server.
- `title: string` (optional). Nonempty visible region name; defaults to the scoped message for the error kind.
- `headingLevel: 1|2|3|4|5|6` (optional). Semantic heading level, default 2; visual heading size stays compact.
- `description: string` (optional). App-localized safe explanation. Do not pass secrets or raw transport errors.
- `onRetry: ()=>void|Promise<void>` (optional). Optional app-owned retry callback. Concurrent attempts are suppressed; rejection shows a scoped generic message. Success does not remove the region.

Accessibility role: region, status
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space
Tokens: `--sheen-color-border`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`, `--sheen-space-block-sm`

Do:
- Keep authorized existing content mounted beside a refresh error.
- Let the app own retry requests and region dismissal.

Do not:
- Do not retain unauthorized content after a permission change.
- Do not expose raw exception messages.
- Do not offer retry when the app has no meaningful retry action.

Example, Permission boundary:
```tsx
<ErrorState kind="permission-denied" description="Ask your workspace administrator for access." />
```

### FocusedAuthLayout

A centered authentication card for concise OAuth, OIDC, SSO, or credential flows.

Category: application

Props:
- `ref: HTMLElement|((element:HTMLElement)=>void)` (optional). Native main-landmark reference.
- `brand: JSX.Element` (required). Persistent app-owned product identity above the authentication card.
- `title: string` (required). Required visible page heading and accessible main-landmark name.
- `description: JSX.Element` (optional). Optional provider, organization, or next-step guidance below the heading.
- `children: JSX.Element` (required). App-owned authentication controls and live status.
- `footer: JSX.Element` (optional). Optional support and legal destinations below the card.
- `headingLevel: 1|2|3|4|5|6` (optional; default 1). Semantic heading level for the visible authentication title.
- `contentWidth: AuthLayoutContentWidth` (optional; default "sm"). Bounded card width.

Accessibility role: main, section, heading, footer
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg`, `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-border`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`, `--sheen-space-section`, `--sheen-elevation-raised`

Do:
- Prefer this layout when authentication is one or two provider actions.
- Give every provider action explicit visible text.
- Keep errors beside the controls and retain the same form owner while retrying.

Do not:
- Do not turn a provider button into a link unless it performs immediate URL navigation.
- Do not imply that the layout performs OAuth or stores credentials.
- Do not replace the card with a spinner during authentication.

Example, OIDC-only sign in:
```tsx
import { Button } from "@gemologic/sheen";
<FocusedAuthLayout brand={<strong>Northstar</strong>} title="Welcome back" description="Use your organization account."><Button variant="solid" tone="accent">Continue with SSO</Button></FocusedAuthLayout>
```

### ListDetailLayout

A persistent URL-driven list and detail workspace with phone focus handoff and pane scroll continuity.

Category: application

Props:
- `router: RouterAdapter` (required). Application router adapter whose accepted location selects the active item.
- `items: readonly ListDetailItem[]` (required). Stable-ID local destinations shown in the list pane.
- `listLabel: string` (required). Accessible name for the list scroll region.
- `detailLabel: string` (required). Accessible name for the persistent detail scroll region.
- `listHref: string` (required). Local destination used by the phone back link.
- `backLabel: string` (required). Localized visible label for the phone back link.
- `detail: JSX.Element` (required). Accepted route detail content; keep retained content here during background refresh.
- `emptyDetail: JSX.Element` (optional). Optional desktop content shown when the URL matches no item.
- `detailReady: boolean` (optional). False while accepted detail content cannot yet restore its saved scroll position.
- `detailPaneId: string` (optional). Stable restoration identity when more than one layout can coexist.

Accessibility role: region, list, link
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home, End, Enter
Tokens: `--sheen-color-border`, `--sheen-color-bg`, `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-bg-hover`, `--sheen-color-bg-selected`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring-offset`

Do:
- Keep the layout mounted in a route layout so list DOM and scroll survive detail navigation.
- Drive detail content from the router's accepted location and retain it during revalidation.

Do not:
- Do not mirror URL selection into optimistic local state.
- Do not replace the layout or either scroll viewport during background refresh.

Example, URL-selected detail:
```tsx
const router = { location: () => ({ pathname: "/inbox/one", search: "", hash: "" }), navigate: () => {}, block: () => () => {} };
<AppShell label="Inbox" router={router}><ListDetailLayout router={router} items={[{ id: "one", label: "First", href: "/inbox/one" }]} listLabel="Messages" detailLabel="Message" listHref="/inbox" backLabel="Back to messages" detail={<article>First message</article>} /></AppShell>
```

### LoadingState

Layout-reserving cold skeletons and delayed refresh progress without remounting content.

Category: application

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required nonempty accessible region name.
- `phase: "idle"|"cold"|"refresh"` (required). Explicit app-owned idle/cold/refresh phase. Cold hides content; refresh preserves it. Timers begin after hydration or a phase change.
- `fallback: JSX.Element` (required). Required noninteractive skeleton matching the app's layout. Cold load reserves its size immediately and reveals it after 200ms.

Accessibility role: region, progressbar
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab
Tokens: `--sheen-color-accent`, `--sheen-duration-slow`

Do:
- Keep the same component mounted while refreshing.
- Supply a layout-matched skeleton and app-owned phase.
- Handle errors and accepted data in the app.

Do not:
- Do not use cold phase for ordinary revalidation.
- Do not retain unauthorized data after an account or permission boundary.
- Do not put interactive controls in the fallback.

Example, Refreshing existing content:
```tsx
import { Skeleton } from "@gemologic/sheen";
<LoadingState label="Orders" phase="refresh" fallback={<Skeleton shape="rectangle" style={{ height: "12rem" }} />}><p>Existing orders</p></LoadingState>
```

### NotificationCenter

A compact app-owned notification trigger and contextual list with non-color unread state.

Category: application

Props:
- `notifications: AdminNotificationModel` (required). Ordered app-owned notifications plus optional mark-all action. Time copy is preformatted by the app.
- `target: "topbar-end"|"sidebar-footer"` (optional; default "topbar-end"). Topbar dropdown or sidebar-footer dropup placement.

Accessibility role: button, dialog, list
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Escape
Tokens: `--sheen-color-accent`, `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`

Do:
- Format dates and authorization-filter items in the app.

Do not:
- Do not fetch, poll, or infer read state in Sheen.

Example, App notifications:
```tsx
import { ThemeProvider } from "@gemologic/sheen";
<ThemeProvider><NotificationCenter notifications={{ items: [{ kind: "link", id: "deploy", title: "Deploy finished", href: "/deploys/1" }] }} /></ThemeProvider>
```

### PageHeader

A compact page heading with persistent breadcrumb, action, and tabs slots.

Category: application

Props:
- `title: string` (required). Required nonempty visible heading and accessible group name.
- `headingLevel: 1|2|3|4|5|6` (optional). Semantic heading level, independent of the compact visual size. Defaults to 1.
- `breadcrumb: JSX.Element` (optional). Optional breadcrumb row above the title/action row.
- `actions: JSX.Element` (optional). Persistent action controls beside the heading, wrapping when space is constrained.
- `tabs: JSX.Element` (optional). Optional tabs row below the heading; tabs retain ownership of keyboard navigation.

Accessibility role: group, heading
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab
Tokens: `--sheen-space-inline-sm`, `--sheen-space-block-xs`, `--sheen-color-border`

Do:
- Choose the heading level to match the document outline.
- Supply Breadcrumb and Tabs components in their named slots.

Do not:
- Do not use this component to set document.title.
- Do not replace the header subtree during background refresh.

Example, Page actions:
```tsx
import { Button } from "@gemologic/sheen";
<PageHeader title="Orders" actions={<Button>Export orders</Button>} />
```

### SettingsLayout

A sectioned settings workspace with stable in-page navigation, app-owned dirty data, and one persistent asynchronous save bar.

Category: application

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Accessible name for the settings workspace.
- `sections: readonly SettingsLayoutSection[]` (required). Stable-ID section labels, optional descriptions, and app-owned setting content.
- `activeSection: string` (optional). Optional controlled section highlighted in the navigation rail.
- `onSectionChange: (id:string)=>void` (optional). Receives navigation intent after a section button is activated.
- `sectionHeadingLevel: 1|2|3|4|5|6` (optional; default 2). Semantic heading level shared by section titles.
- `dirty: boolean` (required). App-owned dirty state registered with the surrounding AppShell navigation guard.
- `onSave: ()=>void|Promise<void>` (required). App save operation. Rejections retain content and expose a localized failure state.
- `onDiscard: ()=>void` (optional). Optional app-owned restoration of the last accepted settings values.
- `saveError: string|null` (optional). Optional app-localized save error retained beside the save controls.

Accessibility role: group, navigation, section, heading, status
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg`, `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-border`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`, `--sheen-space-section`

Do:
- Keep draft and accepted values in the app and return the real save promise.
- Keep the layout mounted while saving and while section data refreshes.
- Pass activeSection when a router or observer owns section selection.

Do not:
- Do not remount section inputs on save or refresh.
- Do not infer dirty state from the DOM.
- Do not hide the save bar when settings become clean and strand keyboard focus.

Example, Dirty settings:
```tsx
import { Input } from "@gemologic/sheen";
const sections = [{ id: "profile", label: "Profile", content: <Input label="Display name" /> }];
<AppShell label="Settings"><SettingsLayout label="Workspace settings" sections={sections} dirty={false} onSave={() => {}} /></AppShell>
```

### SidebarNav

Sectioned native navigation with nested disclosure groups and app-supplied active pathname.

Category: application

Props:
- `sections: readonly SidebarNavSection[]` (required). Named sections containing link/group entries with globally unique nonempty IDs. Links may supply a named action menu rendered beside the destination. Same-ID, same-kind entries retain mounted state across object replacement/reordering within their parent; moving between parents or changing kind creates a new owner.
- `pathname: string` (required). Accepted router pathname. Exact matching is default; prefix matching respects path segments. Longest matching destination wins; ties use declaration order. External destinations are never automatically current.
- `headingLevel: 2|3|4|5|6` (optional). Section heading level, default 3, independent of compact visual size.
- `collapsed: boolean` (optional). App-controlled icon rail. All nested destinations remain reachable; disclosure state returns when expanded. Labels remain accessible with tooltips. Supply icons; missing icons use the first label code point. Requires ThemeProvider in both modes.
- `header: JSX.Element` (optional). Semantic sidebar-header chrome, resolved once and retained across desktop and phone presentations.
- `footer: JSX.Element` (optional). Semantic sidebar-footer chrome, resolved once and retained across desktop and phone presentations.

Accessibility role: navigation, heading, link, button
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space
Tokens: `--sheen-space-block-sm`, `--sheen-space-inline-sm`

Do:
- Pass the accepted router location rather than a pending destination.
- Use native links for destinations, disclosure groups for nesting, and named sibling menus for row actions.

Do not:
- Do not use menu roles for application navigation.
- Do not place interactive controls inside icon or badge slots.

Example, Workspace routes:
```tsx
<SidebarNav pathname="/orders" sections={[{ id: "workspace", label: "Workspace", items: [{ kind: "link", id: "orders", label: "Orders", href: "/orders", match: "prefix" }] }]} />
```

### SplitLayout

Composes two labeled, persisted resizable panes that retain one content owner while stacking in a narrow container.

Category: patterns

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Accessible name for the complete split workspace.
- `startLabel: string` (required). Accessible name for the logical start pane's scroll region.
- `endLabel: string` (required). Accessible name for the logical end pane's scroll region.
- `handleLabel: string` (required). Accessible name for the adjustable separator.
- `start: JSX.Element` (required). Persistent logical start-pane content.
- `end: JSX.Element` (required). Persistent logical end-pane content.
- `orientation: "horizontal"|"vertical"` (optional; default "horizontal"). Horizontal side-by-side or vertical stacked split axis.
- `narrowLayout: "stack"|"split"` (optional; default "stack"). Stacks a horizontal split below the component container breakpoint or retains resizing.
- `sizes: readonly number[]` (optional). Controlled two-pane fractions summing to one.
- `defaultSizes: readonly number[]` (optional). Deterministic initial two-pane fractions summing to one.
- `onSizesChange: (sizes:readonly number[])=>void` (optional). Receives validated immutable fractions after pointer or keyboard resizing.
- `keyboardStep: number` (optional; default 0.05). Fraction moved by each separator arrow-key action.
- `persistence: ResizablePersistence` (optional). App-owned server-known initial sizes, async save adapter, and explicit failure callback.
- `startMinSize: number` (optional; default 0.2). Minimum logical start-pane fraction.
- `startMaxSize: number` (optional). Maximum logical start-pane fraction.
- `endMinSize: number` (optional; default 0.2). Minimum logical end-pane fraction.
- `endMaxSize: number` (optional). Maximum logical end-pane fraction.
- `refreshing: boolean` (optional; default false). Marks retained accepted content busy without hiding or replacing either pane.

Accessibility role: named group containing two named scroll regions and an adjustable separator
Keyboard: Tab focuses each pane and the separator, Arrow keys resize the focused separator, Home and End move it to its bounds
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg`, `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-border`, `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring-offset`

Do:
- Provide server-known initial sizes and let the application persistence adapter save accepted changes.
- Keep both content slots mounted while refreshing or crossing the narrow breakpoint.

Do not:
- Do not read storage on mount and replace server geometry.
- Do not create a second mobile content tree.

Example, Source and preview:
```tsx
<SplitLayout label="Editor" startLabel="Source" endLabel="Preview" handleLabel="Resize source and preview" defaultSizes={[0.4, 0.6]} start={<textarea aria-label="Source draft" />} end={<article>Preview</article>} />
```

### StatusBar

App-owned connection and background task status with localized counts and persistent actions.

Category: application

Props:
- `label: string` (optional). Accessible group name; defaults to the scoped application-status message.
- `connection: ConnectionState` (optional). App-supplied connection state. Omitted state renders no connection indicator; browser connectivity is never detected.
- `tasks: number` (optional). Nonnegative safe-integer pending task count. Zero or omission hides the task indicator.
- `counts: readonly StatusCount[]` (optional). Nonnegative safe-integer counts with unique nonempty app-localized labels, formatted in the scoped locale.

Accessibility role: group, status
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab
Tokens: `--sheen-color-fg-muted`, `--sheen-color-border`, `--sheen-space-inline-sm`

Do:
- Supply backend health from the app.
- Place the bar in AppShell's statusBar slot.
- Localize count labels in the app.

Do not:
- Do not infer backend health from navigator.onLine.
- Do not put rapidly changing counts in a live region.

Example, Workspace status:
```tsx
<StatusBar connection="connected" tasks={2} counts={[{ label: "Rows", value: 1200 }]} />
```

### Toolbar

Measured whole-group actions with scoped overflow and independent filter controls.

Category: application

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required nonempty accessible action-toolbar name.
- `groups: readonly ToolbarGroup[]` (required). Ordered groups with stable IDs and labels, each containing sheen action or checkbox menu items. Whole trailing groups overflow together.
- `filter: JSX.Element` (optional). Persistent filter controls outside the action toolbar's arrow-key navigation.

Accessibility role: toolbar, group, menu
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home, End, Enter, Space, Escape
Tokens: `--sheen-space-inline-sm`, `--sheen-color-border`, `--sheen-control-h-md`

Do:
- Keep IDs stable across state updates.
- Provide three or more actions when using toolbar navigation.

Do not:
- Do not put text inputs into action groups; use the filter slot.
- Do not use action items for URL navigation.

Example, Document actions:
```tsx
<Toolbar label="Document actions" groups={[{ id: "file", label: "File", items: [{ kind: "action", id: "save", label: "Save", onSelect: () => {} }] }]} />
```

### TopNav

Compact horizontal native navigation with active-route matching and roving keyboard focus.

Category: application

Props:
- `navigation: AdminNavigationModel` (required). App-owned navigation tree. Nested links flatten in declaration order for the horizontal presentation.
- `pathname: string` (required). Accepted local pathname used for most-specific exact or segment-prefix matching.
- `compact: boolean` (optional; default true). Compact visual-density marker; behavior and landmark naming do not change.

Accessibility role: navigation, link
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home, End, Enter
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-hover`, `--sheen-color-bg-selected`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`

Do:
- Supply the accepted router pathname and stable item IDs.

Do not:
- Do not use action callbacks for destinations.

Example, Primary top navigation:
```tsx
<TopNav pathname="/orders" navigation={{ id: "primary", label: "Primary", items: [{ kind: "link", id: "orders", label: "Orders", href: "/orders" }] }} />
```

### WorkspaceSwitcher

An app-owned workspace selector with consistent topbar, sidebar-header, and sidebar-footer presentations.

Category: application

Props:
- `workspace: AdminWorkspaceModel` (required). Current workspace, ordered choices, and an app-owned accepted-change callback.
- `target: "topbar-start"|"topbar-end"|"sidebar-header"|"sidebar-footer"` (optional; default "sidebar-header"). Semantic chrome target controlling logical menu direction and alignment.
- `collapsed: boolean` (optional; default false). Icon-rail presentation. The workspace label remains available to assistive technology.

Accessibility role: button, menu, radio
Keyboard: Tab, Enter, Space, ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Escape
Tokens: `--sheen-color-accent`, `--sheen-color-bg-raised`

Do:
- Keep currentId app-owned and stable during refresh.

Do not:
- Do not persist or fetch workspace state inside the selector.

Example, Sidebar workspace:
```tsx
import { ThemeProvider } from "@gemologic/sheen";
<ThemeProvider><WorkspaceSwitcher workspace={{ label: "Workspace", currentId: "alpha", items: [{ id: "alpha", label: "Alpha" }], onChange: () => {} }} /></ThemeProvider>
```

## @gemologic/sheen-table

### DataTable

Virtualized continuous or paginated data with phone cards, selection, layouts, groups, and trees.

Category: data

Props:
- `mode: "client"|"server"` (optional; default "client"). Client processes complete supplied data; server delegates the full query and requires pagination plus onStateChange.
- `data: readonly Row[]` (optional). Complete bounded client dataset. Available only in client mode.
- `initialResult: DataTableResult<Row>` (optional). Optional authoritative server result used for SSR without a duplicate hydration request. Delegated grouping includes groups for the accepted page.
- `onStateChange: (state:TableState,signal:AbortSignal)=>Promise<DataTableResult<Row>>` (optional). Server request adapter receiving complete state and an AbortSignal. Available only in server mode.
- `onExport: (request:TableExportRequest,signal:AbortSignal)=>Promise<Blob>` (optional). Optional server adapter returning a Blob for the captured accepted state and immutable selection. Server export UI is hidden without it.
- `columns: SheenColumns<Row>` (required). Opaque column definitions returned by defineColumns.
- `getRowId: (row:Row)=>string` (required). Returns a stable, unique, nonempty row ID.
- `caption: string` (required). Required accessible table caption, visually hidden by default.
- `variant: DataTableVariant` (optional). Standalone frame or application-pane integration; omission follows context.
- `density: DataTableDensity` (optional). Optional table-local compact, comfortable, or spacious density. Omission inherits the surrounding application density.
- `pagination: TablePagination` (optional). False selects complete continuous results; page state selects numbered pagination. Client defaults false and server requires an explicit choice.
- `initialState: DataTableInitialState` (optional). Optional initial query and column-layout state; pagination remains configured by the pagination prop.
- `filter: FilterNode` (optional). Optional app-owned accepted filter applied reactively without remounting retained rows; onAcceptedStateChange synchronizes table-authored changes.
- `rowHeight: string` (optional; default "var(--sheen-table-row-h)"). CSS length for the fixed row block size or the minimum measured variable-row size.
- `variableRowHeight: boolean` (optional; default false). Allows content-driven row heights and measures each realized row.
- `estimatedRowHeight: number` (optional; default 34). Positive CSS-pixel estimate used before measurement. Defaults to the active compact, comfortable, or spacious row token.
- `initialViewportHeight: number` (optional; default 400). Positive CSS-pixel viewport size used for deterministic server rendering and hydration.
- `class: string` (optional). Optional class merged onto the table region.
- `onAcceptedStateChange: (state:TableState)=>void` (optional). Receives accepted query states and locally committed layout states; transient resize frames are excluded.
- `onRowActivate: (row:Row)=>void` (optional). Enables roving row focus and receives Enter activation for the focused row.
- `selection: DataTableSelectionOptions<Row>` (optional). Enables table-owned multiple selection, optional authorization-boundary resetKey, and immutable explicit-ID or query/exclusion payloads.
- `actions: readonly DataTableAction<Row>[]` (optional). One validated action model rendered in the bottom selection bar and each accepted row's context menu.
- `mobileLayout: boolean|DataTableMobileLayoutOptions` (optional). Opt-in card presentation below 768px. Continuous results use local bounded pages of 20 cards by default; numbered tables keep their configured page.
- `grouping: DataTableGroupingOptions` (optional). Groups a complete continuous client view, or validates explicit full-query group metadata supplied with each delegated server page.
- `hierarchy: DataTableHierarchyOptions<Row>` (optional). Provides synchronous children and optional app-loaded subtrees with independent cancellation, retry, stale-response rejection, and authorization reset.
- `search: false|DataTableSearchOptions` (optional). Configures automatic search over explicitly searchable columns, or false disables it; options supply label, placeholder, debounce, shortcut, and an opt-in Exact mode that matches a literal phrase within one searchable column.
- `filterBar: boolean|DataTableFilterBarOptions` (optional; default true). Shows typed filters declared by columns; options may inject an isolated date editor without adding it to the table bundle.
- `columnControls: boolean` (optional; default true). Shows the keyboard-accessible visibility, ordering, pinning, auto-fit, and width-reset menu.
- `export: false|DataTableExportOptions` (optional). Client export is enabled by default; false hides it, while options constrain formats and set a filename base.
- `onCellCommit: (request:DataTableCellCommitRequest<Row>,signal:AbortSignal)=>Promise<CellCommitResult<ColumnValue,string>>` (optional). Required by editable columns; receives row/column context, a per-cell commit ID, previous/value snapshot, and AbortSignal, then reports acceptance or an explicit conflict.
- `editResetKey: string|number` (optional). Discards drafts, conflicts, failed attempts, and pending commits when an account or permission boundary changes.

Accessibility role: table or treegrid, row, gridcell, columnheader, list, listitem, checkbox, toolbar, menu, separator, navigation, status
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Shift+F10, ContextMenu, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, Enter, Space, Shift+Space, Control+A, Meta+A
Tokens: `--sheen-table-row-h`, `--sheen-color-border`, `--sheen-color-bg`, `--sheen-color-bg-raised`

Do:
- Use continuous client mode for bounded local datasets.
- Use numbered server pagination for large or expensive remote results.
- Enable mobileLayout when a table must be functional on phones; tune its bounded continuous page size to row complexity.
- Supply full-query counts and aggregates when the server delegates grouping.
- Provide initialResult when server rendering already fetched the accepted page.
- Define row actions once so context, card overflow, and bulk paths cannot drift.
- Return complete server exports from onExport rather than walking pages in the component.
- Return explicit conflict results from onCellCommit instead of parsing transport error text.
- Change selection.resetKey, hierarchy.resetKey, export.resetKey, and editResetKey when the user's authorization or account boundary changes.
- Keep column controls enabled when users can drag, so every layout action has a keyboard path.

Do not:
- Do not use pagination=false for an incomplete server response or infinite fetching.
- Do not render an unbounded phone card list; mobileLayout limits continuous pages to at most 100 cards.
- Do not calculate group totals from one server page.
- Do not paginate, sort, filter, or export one server page locally and present it as the complete query.
- Do not materialize all-matching selection by walking server pages or offer it for a hierarchy whose subtree query cannot be represented.
- Do not request server data for visibility, order, pin, or width-only changes.

Example, Bounded continuous data:
```tsx
const columns = defineColumns<{ readonly id: string; readonly name: string; readonly amount: number }>([
  { id: "name", header: "Name", accessor: row => row.name, search: true },
  { id: "amount", header: "Amount", accessor: row => row.amount, numeric: true },
]);
const rows = [{ id: "one", name: "Alpha", amount: 12 }, { id: "two", name: "Beta", amount: 34 }];
<DataTable data={rows} columns={columns} getRowId={row => row.id} caption="Accounts" pagination={false} mobileLayout={{ pageSize: 20, titleColumn: "name" }} initialViewportHeight={160} />
```

### FilterBar

Edits the accepted serializable filter AST through removable condition chips and typed draft popovers.

Category: data

Props:
- `columns: SheenColumns<Row>` (required). Opaque sheen columns whose filter declarations supply labels, types, enum options, and validation.
- `value: FilterNode` (required). Accepted immutable filter AST. Nested and/or/not structure is preserved during leaf edits.
- `onChange: (filter:FilterNode)=>void` (required). Receives one validated immutable AST when a draft is applied or a chip is removed.
- `facets: Readonly<Record<string,Readonly<Record<string,number>>>>` (optional). Optional accepted enum counts by column and option, typically from the complete client view or server response.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Prevents apply, add, and remove intent while retaining visible accepted chips and draft inspection.
- `class: string` (optional). Additional class merged onto the labeled filter region.
- `dateEditor: FilterDateEditor` (optional). Optional isolated date selector adapter; omission preserves the native date-input fallback and table bundle boundary.

Accessibility role: group, dialog, searchbox, button, checkbox
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Escape
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`

Do:
- Keep the accepted AST controlled by the same owner as table state.
- Use enum facets from the complete transformed result, not the visible page.
- Apply editor drafts atomically and retain accepted rows during delegated revalidation.

Do not:
- Do not flatten imported nested logic into a misleading conjunction.
- Do not dispatch server requests on each draft keystroke.
- Do not interpret native date values in the browser's local time zone.

Example, Accepted enum filter:
```tsx
import { createSignal } from "solid-js";
import type { FilterNode } from "@gemologic/sheen-table";
const columns = defineColumns<{ readonly id: string; readonly name: string; readonly status: string }>([
  { id: "name", header: "Name", accessor: row => row.name, filter: { type: "text" } },
  { id: "status", header: "Status", accessor: row => row.status, filter: { type: "enum", options: ["open", "closed"], faceted: true } },
]);
const [filter, setFilter] = createSignal<FilterNode>({ kind: "enum", column: "status", operator: "in", values: ["open"] });
<FilterBar columns={columns} value={filter()} onChange={setFilter} facets={{ status: { open: 12, closed: 4 } }} />
```

### QueryBuilder

Builds nested, typed, serializable table filters with complete keyboard alternatives to structural editing.

Category: data

Props:
- `columns: readonly QueryBuilderColumn[]` (required). Typed query columns with user-facing labels and closed enum options.
- `value: FilterNode` (required). Controlled immutable filter AST shared with DataTable, URL state, and saved views.
- `onChange: (filter:FilterNode)=>void` (required). Receives a validated immutable AST after each complete editor operation.
- `label: string` (optional; default "Query builder"). Accessible region label.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Retains the visible query while preventing edits.

Accessibility role: region, group, button, listbox, checkbox, spinbutton, status
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Escape, ArrowUp, ArrowDown
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg`, `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`

Do:
- Control the builder and DataTable from the same accepted filter state.
- Serialize only through serializeFilter and validate URL or saved-view input with deserializeFilter.
- Offer move buttons even when a product later adds drag reordering.

Do not:
- Do not dispatch remote requests from partial input drafts.
- Do not encode executable predicates or CSS in persisted query state.
- Do not flatten nested and, or, or not nodes for display.

Example, Nested account query:
```tsx
import { createSignal } from "solid-js";
import type { FilterNode, QueryBuilderColumn } from "@gemologic/sheen-table/core";
const queryColumns = [
  { id: "name", label: "Name", type: "text" },
  { id: "status", label: "Status", type: "enum", options: ["active", "paused"] },
] satisfies readonly QueryBuilderColumn[];
const [filter, setFilter] = createSignal<FilterNode>({ kind: "and", children: [
  { kind: "text", column: "name", operator: "contains", value: "Acme", caseSensitive: false },
] });
<QueryBuilder columns={queryColumns} value={filter()} onChange={setFilter} label="Account query" />
```

## @gemologic/sheen

### Accordion

Coordinates expansion and keyboard navigation for related disclosure sections.

Category: navigation

Props:
- `value: string[]` (optional). Controlled expanded item values.
- `defaultValue: string[]` (optional). Initially expanded uncontrolled item values.
- `onValueChange: (value:string[])=>void` (optional). Requested expanded values; controlled owners may reject changes.
- `multiple: boolean` (optional; default false). Allow multiple sections to remain expanded.
- `collapsible: boolean` (optional; default true). Allow the selected single-mode section to close.

Accessibility role: group of disclosure headings
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Home, End
Tokens: `--sheen-duration-normal`, `--sheen-space-block-sm`

Do:
- Use stable, unique item values.
- Use a heading level appropriate to the surrounding document.

Do not:
- Do not use an accordion as a tab interface or route navigation.

Example, Settings sections:
```tsx
<Accordion><AccordionItem value="general" label="General"><Input label="Name" /></AccordionItem></Accordion>
```

### AccordionItem

A heading, disclosure trigger, and retained panel inside Accordion.

Category: navigation

Props:
- `value: string` (required). Stable unique value identifying this section.
- `label: string` (required). Visible heading-button label.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Disable this trigger without changing its expanded state.
- `headingLevel: 2|3|4|5|6` (optional; default 3). Native heading level, from two through six.

Accessibility role: heading containing disclosure button
Keyboard: Enter, Space, Tab, ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Home, End
Tokens: `--sheen-color-fg`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`, `--sheen-space-block-sm`

Do not:
- Do not assume closing disables form submission or application effects.

Example, Details section:
