
### ActivityTimeline

A stable chronological list with complete, current, upcoming, and error states encoded by text and shape.

Category: data display

Props:
- `ref: HTMLOListElement|((element:HTMLOListElement)=>void)` (optional). Native ordered-list reference.
- `label: string` (required). Required accessible timeline name.
- `items: readonly ActivityTimelineItem[]` (required). Stable-ID chronological records with visible state, optional description/actor, and paired machine/display time.
- `density: "compact"|"default"` (optional; default "default"). Default or compact vertical rhythm.
- `refreshing: boolean` (optional; default false). Marks accepted items busy without replacing or dimming them.

Accessibility role: ordered list of article entries
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-color-accent-subtle`, `--sheen-color-success-subtle`, `--sheen-color-danger-subtle`

Do:
- Keep item IDs stable across refresh and provide a display label with every machine timestamp.

Do not:
- Do not rely on marker color alone; the visible state label is part of the contract.

Example, Deployment activity:
```tsx
<ActivityTimeline label="Deployment activity" items={[{ id: "approved", title: "Approved", state: "completed", timestamp: "2026-09-08T18:00:00Z", timeLabel: "2:00 PM" }, { id: "deploying", title: "Deploying", state: "current" }]} />
```

### Alert

An urgent, persistent message that does not move focus or dismiss itself.

Category: feedback

Props:
- `tone: "info"|"success"|"warning"|"danger"` (optional; default "danger"). Semantic notice role, independent of the accent preset.
- `heading: string` (optional). Optional visible summary; does not change the document heading outline.

Accessibility role: alert
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-color-info-subtle`, `--sheen-color-info-fg`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring-offset`

Do:
- Use for dynamically appearing important information without stealing focus.

Do not:
- Do not auto-dismiss an alert or focus it when it appears.

Example, Alert composition:
```tsx
<Alert heading="Save failed">Your draft is retained. Try saving again.</Alert>
```

### AlertDialog

An interrupting modal with required explanation and explicit dismissal.

Category: overlays

Props:
- `description: string` (required). Required explanatory text associated with the alert dialog.
- `title: string` (required). Accessible dialog title.
- `contentId: string` (optional). Optional stable content element ID for an external aria-controls relationship. Must be unique in the document.
- `trigger: string` (optional). Visible label for the opening button.
- `open: boolean` (optional). Controlled open state; rejected close requests retain the modal.
- `defaultOpen: boolean` (optional; default false). Uncontrolled initial open state; portal content mounts when the theme target is ready.
- `onOpenChange: (open:boolean)=>void` (optional). Requests a change in open state without mutating controlled ownership.
- `dismissible: boolean` (optional; default true). Allows Escape, outside press, and the close action; false disables all three.
- `closeLabel: string` (optional). Visible and accessible close-action label; defaults to the scoped close message.
- `initialFocus: ()=>HTMLElement` (optional). Resolves an enabled focus target inside the mounted dialog.
- `returnFocus: ()=>HTMLElement` (optional). Optional surviving focus target after closing, useful for triggerless dialogs.
- `shortcutScope: string` (optional). Unique modal shortcut scope ID, defaulting to an internal stable ID. Within ShortcutProvider, opening suspends outer scopes automatically. Register modal actions under this ID; do not reuse an application/global scope.
- `class: string` (optional). Additional classes on modal content.
- `footer: JSX.Element` (optional). App-owned footer actions beside the built-in close action.

Accessibility role: alertdialog
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Escape
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-bg-overlay`, `--sheen-elevation-modal`

Do:
- Keep initial focus on the safe action for destructive decisions.

Do not:
- Do not use alert dialogs for routine nonblocking status messages.

Example, Review a destructive operation:
```tsx
<AlertDialog title="Remove workspace?" description="This removes the workspace and its saved views." trigger="Review removal" closeLabel="Keep workspace" />
```

### Avatar

Shows a labeled identity image with a deterministic text fallback.

Category: data

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required accessible identity label.
- `src: string` (optional). Optional image URL; load failure reveals the fallback.
- `fallback: string` (optional). Optional fallback text, otherwise initials are derived from label.
- `size: AvatarSize` (optional; default "md"). Token-sized avatar.

Accessibility role: img
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-icon-size-sm`, `--sheen-icon-size-md`, `--sheen-icon-size-lg`, `--sheen-color-bg-inset`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`

Do:
- Provide the person's or entity's useful accessible name.

Do not:
- Do not repeat a visible adjacent name in the label if that duplication harms the reading flow.

Example, Identity fallback:
```tsx
<Avatar label="Ada Lovelace" />
```

### AvatarGroup

Presents a labeled bounded set of identities and a localized overflow count.

Category: data

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Accessible name for the identity group.
- `avatars: readonly AvatarItem[]` (required). Ordered identities with stable unique IDs.
- `max: number` (optional; default 5). Maximum visible identities before the overflow count.
- `size: AvatarSize` (optional; default "md"). Shared token size.

Accessibility role: group
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-space-inline-xs`, `--sheen-color-bg-inset`, `--sheen-color-border-control`

Do:
- Keep input order meaningful and IDs stable.

Do not:
- Do not use the overflow badge as an unlabeled action.

Example, Reviewers:
```tsx
const reviewers = [{ id: "ada", label: "Ada Lovelace" }, { id: "grace", label: "Grace Hopper" }];
<AvatarGroup label="Reviewers" avatars={reviewers} />
```

### Badge

A non-interactive status label with independently themed status and market roles.

Category: data display

Props:
- `tone: StatusTone` (optional; default "neutral"). Semantic status or market role, independent of the selected accent.
- `variant: "soft"|"solid"|"outline"` (optional; default "soft"). Soft fill, solid fill, or outline treatment.
- `size: "sm"|"md"` (optional; default "sm"). Density-aware label size.

Accessibility role: status label, not an automatic live region
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-text-caption-size`, `--sheen-color-success-fg`, `--sheen-color-success-subtle`

Do:
- Use visible text as well as color to communicate meaning.

Do not:
- Do not use Badge as a button or make every badge a live region.

Example, Badge example:
```tsx
<Badge tone="success">Healthy</Badge>
```

### Breadcrumb

A labeled hierarchy of native ancestor links ending in the current page.

Category: navigation

Props:
- `items: readonly BreadcrumbEntry[]` (required). Nonempty ordered path with stable unique IDs and nonempty labels. Ancestors require href; the final item renders as current-page text.
- `label: string` (optional). Navigation landmark label, defaulting to the scoped breadcrumb message.

Accessibility role: navigation
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter
Tokens: `--sheen-color-fg`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`, `--sheen-space-inline-sm`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`

Do:
- Use real URLs so links support normal browser navigation and opening in another tab.
- Keep IDs stable when labels refresh.

Do not:
- Do not use breadcrumbs for action buttons or tab selection.
- Do not hide the current page or truncate away its accessible name.

Example, Workspace path:
```tsx
<Breadcrumb items={[{ id: "workspace", label: "Workspace", href: "/" }, { id: "settings", label: "Settings" }]} />
```

### Button

Triggers an action. Use a link for navigation.

Category: primitives

Props:
- `variant: NonNullable<"solid"|"soft"|"outline"|"ghost"|"link">` (optional; default "ghost"). Visual treatment; solid accent actions should be rare.
- `tone: NonNullable<"neutral"|"accent"|"danger"|"success">` (optional; default "neutral"). Semantic color role, independent of visual treatment.
- `size: NonNullable<"xs"|"sm"|"md"|"lg">` (optional; default "md"). Density-aware control size.
- `loading: boolean` (optional; default false). Marks pending work and disables activation.
- `shortcut: ShortcutAction` (optional). Typed shortcut registration whose action invokes this native button; omitted controls remain ordinary buttons.

Accessibility role: button
Keyboard: Enter, Space
Tokens: `--sheen-button-radius`, `--sheen-control-h-md`, `--sheen-color-accent`

Do:
- Keep existing content visible while an action is pending.

Do not:
- Do not use Button for URL navigation.

Example, Quiet action:
```tsx
<Button>Cancel</Button>
```

Example, Primary action:
```tsx
<Button variant="solid" tone="accent">Save changes</Button>
```

Example, Shortcut action:
```tsx
<Button shortcut={{ keys: "mod+s", scope: "global", label: "Save changes", group: "Editing" }}>Save changes</Button>
```

### ButtonGroup

A labeled group of related native actions with horizontal or vertical layout.

Category: primitives

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required nonempty accessible group name.
- `orientation: "horizontal"|"vertical"` (optional). Layout direction, horizontal by default; does not change keyboard behavior.

Accessibility role: group
Keyboard: Tab visits enabled actions in DOM order, Enter and Space activate native buttons
Tokens: `--sheen-space-inline-xs`

Do:
- Give each button its own accessible name, disabled state, and action.

Do not:
- Do not use this as a single-selection control.
- Use Toolbar for a toolbar's roving keyboard model.

Example, Document actions:
```tsx
<ButtonGroup label="Document actions"><Button>Save</Button><Button>Discard</Button></ButtonGroup>
```

### Callout

Static contextual information, not an urgent live-region announcement.

Category: feedback

Props:
- `tone: "info"|"success"|"warning"|"danger"` (optional; default "info"). Semantic notice role, independent of the accent preset.
- `heading: string` (optional). Optional visible summary; does not change the document heading outline.

Accessibility role: note
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-color-info-subtle`, `--sheen-color-info-fg`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring-offset`

Do:
- Use role tokens and preserve the surrounding keyboard order.

Do not:
- Do not use urgent announcements for static explanatory content.

Example, Callout composition:
```tsx
<Callout heading="Retention policy">History is retained for 30 days.</Callout>
```

### Card

A bordered raised surface, without a shadow unless explicitly requested.

Category: surfaces

Props:
- `variant: "base"|"subtle"|"raised"|"inset"` (optional; default "raised"). Semantic surface fill; also establishes the focus-ring offset for descendants.
- `padding: Spacing` (optional; default "lg"). Role-based padding; none leaves spacing to the composition.
- `bordered: boolean` (optional; default true). Adds a structural border, not an interactive-control boundary.
- `elevated: boolean` (optional; default false). Opt-in raised shadow. Keep elevation sparse.

Accessibility role: generic surface
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-border`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring-offset`

Do:
- Use role tokens and preserve the surrounding keyboard order.

Do not:
- Do not add structural borders or shadows merely as decoration.

Example, Card composition:
```tsx
<Card><Heading level={2} size="h3">Workspace</Heading><Text>Project details</Text></Card>
```

### Center

Centers content within the space allocated by its parent.

Category: layout

Props:

Accessibility role: presentation layout
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-space-block-md`, `--sheen-space-inline-md`

Do:
- Preserve logical DOM order and use token spacing.

Do not:
- Do not use layout wrappers to invent inaccessible keyboard order.

Example, Center composition:
```tsx
<Center><Button>Continue</Button></Center>
```

### Checkbox

A labeled native checkbox with controlled, uncontrolled, and mixed presentation.

Category: forms

Props:
- `id: string` (optional). Root container ID, also used to derive stable internal IDs.
- `ref: HTMLDivElement|((element:HTMLDivElement)=>void)` (optional). Root container reference; use inputRef for the native input.
- `onPointerDown: NonNullable<JSX.EventHandlerUnion<HTMLDivElement,PointerEvent,JSX.EventHandler<HTMLDivElement,PointerEvent>>>` (optional). Native root pointer-down handler, composed with primitive focus behavior.
- `label: string` (required). Required visible label.
- `description: string` (optional). Supporting text associated with the native input.
- `error: string` (optional). Associated validation error; marks the input invalid without moving focus.
- `checked: boolean` (optional). App-owned checked value, retained across form reset unless the app changes it.
- `defaultChecked: boolean` (optional; default false). Initial uncontrolled checked value restored on form reset.
- `indeterminate: boolean` (optional; default false). App-owned mixed presentation; clear it explicitly when resolving a partial selection.
- `onCheckedChange: (checked:boolean)=>void` (optional). Receives requested checked changes, not a DOM event.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Disables activation, keyboard focus, and form submission.
- `readOnly: boolean` (optional; default false). Prevents changes while retaining focus and submission.
- `required: boolean` (optional; default false). Requires this checkbox to be checked for native form validation.
- `name: string` (optional). Native form field name; omitted or empty names are not submitted.
- `form: string` (optional). ID of an owning form outside the input's ancestry; forwarded to the native input.
- `value: string` (optional; default "on"). Submitted value when checked.
- `inputRef: (element:HTMLInputElement)=>void` (optional). Receives the native input; ref and remaining DOM props belong to the root container.

Accessibility role: checkbox
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Space
Tokens: `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-color-accent`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`, `--sheen-icon-size-md`

Do:
- Use mixed state for partial selections and update it explicitly.

Do not:
- Do not use a checkbox for an immediate on/off setting that needs switch semantics.

Example, Opt in:
```tsx
<Checkbox label="Receive alerts" name="alerts" description="Send alerts for this workspace." />
```

### CheckboxGroup

A native fieldset of independent choices with shared selection ownership.

Category: forms

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required visible group legend.
- `options: readonly CheckboxOption[]` (required). Options keyed by unique value; replacing objects or reordering retains surviving controls.
- `value: readonly string[]` (optional). App-owned selected values; reset does not change them unless the app does.
- `defaultValue: readonly string[]` (optional). Captured uncontrolled initial selection restored by uncanceled reset.
- `onValueChange: (value:string[])=>void` (optional). Receives a fresh deduplicated selection array on changes.
- `description: string` (optional). Supporting instructions associated with the fieldset.
- `error: string` (optional). Group validation message; marks the fieldset invalid without moving focus.
- `readOnly: boolean` (optional; default false). Prevents option changes while retaining focus and form values.

Accessibility role: group
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Space
Tokens: `--sheen-space-block-sm`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`, `--sheen-color-danger-fg`

Do:
- Use unique stable values and short group legends.
- Validate minimum selections in the app and provide a group error.

Do not:
- Do not mark every checkbox required to require at least one selection.

Example, Alert channels:
```tsx
<CheckboxGroup label="Alert channels" name="channels" options={[{ value: "email", label: "Email" }, { value: "desktop", label: "Desktop" }]} defaultValue={["email"]} />
```

### Cluster

Row alias for wrapping groups of related controls.

Category: layout

Props:
- `wrap: boolean` (optional; default true). Wrap onto additional lines when inline space is exhausted.
- `gap: Spacing` (optional; default "md"). Role-based spacing that follows the active density.
- `align: Alignment` (optional; default "center"). Cross-axis alignment without changing DOM or keyboard order.
- `justify: Justification` (optional; default "start"). Main-axis distribution without reversing content order.

Accessibility role: presentation layout
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-space-block-md`, `--sheen-space-inline-md`

Do:
- Preserve logical DOM order and use token spacing.

Do not:
- Do not use layout wrappers to invent inaccessible keyboard order.

Example, Cluster composition:
```tsx
<Cluster><Button>One</Button><Button>Two</Button></Cluster>
```

### Code

Inline code, rendered as code with the mono type role. Syntax highlighting belongs to CodeBlock.

Category: typography

Props:

Accessibility role: code
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-font-sans`, `--sheen-font-mono`, `--sheen-color-fg`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`

Do:
- Use visible text as well as color to communicate meaning.

Do not:
- Do not use low-contrast subtle tokens for meaningful text.

Example, Code example:
```tsx
<Code>workspace.id</Code>
```

### Collapsible

A native disclosure button with persistent, inert-when-closed content.

Category: navigation

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Visible disclosure-button label.
- `open: boolean` (optional). App-owned expanded state; owners may reject requested changes.
- `defaultOpen: boolean` (optional; default false). Initial uncontrolled expanded state, including SSR.
- `onOpenChange: (open:boolean)=>void` (optional). Requested expanded-state changes.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Disables user activation without hiding already expanded content.

Accessibility role: button with aria-expanded and aria-controls
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space
Tokens: `--sheen-color-fg-muted`, `--sheen-space-block-sm`, `--sheen-duration-normal`, `--sheen-ease-standard`

Do:
- Keep a stable disclosure owner while its content refreshes.
- Use independent disclosures for independent sections.

Do not:
- Do not use a disclosure as a substitute for route navigation.
- Do not put interactive elements inside its label.

Example, Advanced settings:
```tsx
<Collapsible label="Advanced settings"><Input label="Timeout" /></Collapsible>
```

### Combobox

Editable single selection with retained async results.

Category: forms

Props:
- `value: string|null` (optional). Controlled selected value; null explicitly clears selection.
- `defaultValue: string|null` (optional). Initial uncontrolled selected value.
- `onValueChange: (value:string|null)=>void` (optional). Receives committed option values, never free-form input.
- `label: string` (required). Required visible label.
- `options: readonly ComboboxOption[]` (required). Accepted options with unique nonempty values and labels.
- `name: string` (optional). Native hidden-select form name.
- `form: string` (optional). Optional external form ID.
- `placeholder: string` (optional). Text shown while the editable input is empty.
- `description: string` (optional). Supporting text associated with the input.
- `error: string` (optional). Field validation text and invalid state.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Disables input, selection, and submission.
- `readOnly: boolean` (optional; default false). Allows inspection but rejects edits.
- `required: boolean` (optional; default false). Requires a committed selection for native form submission.
- `filter: ComboboxFilter` (optional; default "contains"). Built-in label filter, or false when the app supplies externally filtered options.
- `onInputChange: (value:string)=>void` (optional). Receives editable query changes; the app owns debounce, cancellation, and request ordering.
- `pending: boolean` (optional; default false). Retains the last accepted result nodes and prevents stale selection while the next result set is pending.
- `resultsError: string` (optional). Nonblocking async-result error; field validation remains separate.
- `onRetry: ()=>void` (optional). Optional retry action shown with resultsError.
- `inputRef: (element:HTMLInputElement)=>void` (optional). Receives the visible native input.

Accessibility role: combobox
Keyboard: ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Home, End, Enter, Escape
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-inset`, `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`

Do:
- Set pending before replacing externally fetched options, then publish the accepted result set atomically.

Do not:
- Do not commit free-form query text as the selected value.

Example, App-owned results:
```tsx
<Combobox label="Owner" options={[{ value: "ada", label: "Ada" }]} defaultValue="ada" />
```

### CommandPalette

Searches static, remote and registered shortcut commands with retained refresh results and app-owned recents.

Category: overlays

Props:
- `sources: readonly CommandPaletteSource[]` (required). Static and abortable remote command sources with stable IDs.
- `open: boolean` (optional). Controlled open state.
- `defaultOpen: boolean` (optional; default false). Initial uncontrolled open state.
- `onOpenChange: (open:boolean)=>void` (optional). Receives open-state requests.
- `recents: CommandPaletteRecents` (optional). Server-known recent IDs plus app-owned persistence.
- `shortcutScope: string` (optional; default "global"). Scope where mod+k opens the mounted palette.
- `onSourceError: (sourceId:string,error:unknown)=>void` (optional). Reports a failed remote source without clearing accepted results.
- `onCommandError: (commandId:string,error:unknown)=>void` (optional). Reports a selected command failure.
- `class: string` (optional). Additional class on the command root.

Accessibility role: dialog containing a combobox and listbox
Keyboard: mod+k, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Enter, Escape
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-border`, `--sheen-color-bg-selected`, `--sheen-elevation-overlay`

Do:
- Provide stable command IDs and server-known initial remote results.

Do not:
- Do not read recents on mount or blank accepted results during remote search.

Example, Application commands:
```tsx
import type { CommandPaletteSource } from "@gemologic/sheen";
const sources: readonly CommandPaletteSource[] = [{ kind: "static", id: "app", commands: [{ id: "settings", label: "Open settings", group: "Navigation", run: () => {} }] }];
<ShortcutProvider development><CommandPalette sources={sources} /></ShortcutProvider>
```

### ConfirmDialog

A controlled confirmation decision with safe initial focus.

Category: overlays

Props:
- `open: boolean` (required). App-owned visibility.
- `onConfirm: ()=>void` (required). Affirmative decision callback. The app owns closing and subsequent operations.
- `onCancel: ()=>void` (required). Cancellation callback for the safe action or Escape. Outside clicks do not cancel.
- `confirmLabel: string` (optional). Affirmative action label, defaulting to the scoped confirm message.
- `cancelLabel: string` (optional). Safe action label, defaulting to the scoped cancel message.
- `tone: "accent"|"danger"` (optional; default "accent"). Affirmative action tone.
- `title: string` (required). Required visible and accessible title.
- `contentId: string` (optional). Optional unique content ID, forwarded to AlertDialog.
- `description: string` (required). Required explanation of the decision and its consequences.
- `returnFocus: (()=>HTMLElement)` (optional). Optional surviving focus target when the prompt closes.
- `shortcutScope: string` (optional). Unique modal shortcut scope ID, forwarded to AlertDialog. Open confirmations automatically suspend outer shortcut scopes within ShortcutProvider.
- `class: string` (optional). Additional modal content classes.

Accessibility role: alertdialog
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Escape
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`, `--sheen-elevation-modal`

Do:
- Mount the controller Dialog once in the creating owner's theme scope.

Do not:
- Do not start irreversible work before the confirmation promise resolves true.

Example, Imperative confirmation:
```tsx
const decision = createConfirm();
<><Button onClick={() => { void decision.confirm({ title: "Remove workspace?", description: "Saved views will be removed.", tone: "danger" }); }}>Review removal</Button><decision.Dialog /></>
```

### Container

Full-width content boundary with token padding, without centering or imposing a document width.

Category: layout

Props:
- `padding: Spacing` (optional; default "md"). Role-based spacing that follows the active density.

Accessibility role: presentation layout
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-space-block-md`, `--sheen-space-inline-md`

Do:
- Preserve logical DOM order and use token spacing.

Do not:
- Do not use layout wrappers to invent inaccessible keyboard order.

Example, Container composition:
```tsx
<Container><Stack><Input label="Name" /><Button>Save</Button></Stack></Container>
```

### ContextMenu

Adds a scope-aware action menu without suppressing the native menu when no replacement is available.

Category: overlays

Props:
- `as: "div"|"tr"|"li"` (optional; default "div"). Native div, li, or table-row trigger retained in the document.
- `items: readonly MenuItem[]` (required). Validated action, checkbox, radio, separator, and submenu definitions shared with DropdownMenu.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Leaves the platform context menu available and prevents long-press replacement.
- `onOpenChange: (open:boolean)=>void` (optional). Receives requested open-state changes.
- `menuClass: string` (optional). Additional class on the portaled menu surface.

Accessibility role: menu and native trigger semantics
Keyboard: Shift+F10, ContextMenu, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home, End, Enter, Space, Escape
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`, `--sheen-elevation-overlay`

Do:
- Use the same action source as the visible overflow or selection controls.
- Disable or omit empty replacements so the native browser menu remains available.

Do not:
- Do not suppress contextmenu without opening an equivalent accessible menu.
- Do not make right-click the only way to reach an action.

Example, Row actions:
```tsx
<ContextMenu as="div" items={[{ kind: "action", id: "open", label: "Open", onSelect: () => {} }]}>Account A</ContextMenu>
```

### DescriptionDetails

A semantic value in a description list, optionally using tabular figures.

Category: data-display

Props:
- `numeric: boolean` (optional; default false). Enable tabular figures for numeric values; formatting remains app-owned or uses the context locale formatter.

Accessibility role: native dd
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-color-fg`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`, `--sheen-text-ui-size`, `--sheen-space-block-md`, `--sheen-space-inline-lg`

Do:
- Compose terms and details inside DescriptionList. Use one term/details pair per row in columns layout.
- Use stacked layout for multiple terms or descriptions in a semantic group.

Do not:
- Do not use description lists as an interactive table or arbitrary layout grid.

Example, Order details:
```tsx
<DescriptionList layout="columns"><DescriptionTerm>Symbol</DescriptionTerm><DescriptionDetails>BTC</DescriptionDetails><DescriptionTerm>Quantity</DescriptionTerm><DescriptionDetails numeric>1.25</DescriptionDetails></DescriptionList>
```

### DescriptionList

A native description list for related names and values.

Category: data-display

Props:
- `layout: "stacked"|"columns"` (optional; default "stacked"). Stacked labels and values, or columns using one term followed by one details element per pair.

Accessibility role: native dl
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-color-fg`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`, `--sheen-text-ui-size`, `--sheen-space-block-md`, `--sheen-space-inline-lg`

Do:
- Compose terms and details inside DescriptionList. Use one term/details pair per row in columns layout.
- Use stacked layout for multiple terms or descriptions in a semantic group.

Do not:
- Do not use description lists as an interactive table or arbitrary layout grid.

Example, Order details:
```tsx
<DescriptionList layout="columns"><DescriptionTerm>Symbol</DescriptionTerm><DescriptionDetails>BTC</DescriptionDetails><DescriptionTerm>Quantity</DescriptionTerm><DescriptionDetails numeric>1.25</DescriptionDetails></DescriptionList>
```

### DescriptionTerm

A semantic name in a description list.

Category: data-display

Props:

Accessibility role: native dt
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-color-fg`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`, `--sheen-text-ui-size`, `--sheen-space-block-md`, `--sheen-space-inline-lg`

- Compose terms and details inside DescriptionList. Use one term/details pair per row in columns layout.
