### Tabs

Named tab panels with stable identities, retained drafts, and scoped keyboard navigation.

Category: navigation

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required accessible name for the tab list.
- `items: readonly TabOption[]` (required). Ordered tabs with stable unique values, labels, and optional disabled state.
- `value: string` (optional). Controlled selected value.
- `defaultValue: string` (optional). Initial uncontrolled value; defaults to the first enabled tab.
- `onValueChange: (value:string)=>void` (optional). Requests selection; controlled owners may reject it.
- `orientation: "horizontal"|"vertical"` (optional; default "horizontal"). Tab list layout and arrow-key axis.
- `activationMode: "automatic"|"manual"` (optional; default "automatic"). Automatic selects on arrow navigation; manual requires Enter or Space.
- `children: (value:string)=>JSX.Element` (required). Panel renderer, mounted once per stable item value and retained while inactive.

Accessibility role: tablist, tab, tabpanel
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home, End, Enter, Space
Tokens: `--sheen-color-fg`, `--sheen-color-border`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`

Do:
- Keep values stable during refresh.
- Use manual activation when selection starts expensive work.

Do not:
- Do not use tabs as a substitute for URL navigation.
- Do not assume inactive panels stop effects or native form submission.

Example, Settings panels:
```tsx
<Tabs label="Settings" items={[{ value: "general", label: "General" }, { value: "advanced", label: "Advanced" }]}>{value => <Input label={`${value} name`} />}</Tabs>
```

### Tag

A labeled chip with optional native-button removal; collection state remains app-owned.

Category: data display

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Plain-text tag identity, also used by the default accessible remove label.
- `onRemove: ()=>void` (optional). App-owned removal callback. The app updates the collection and restores focus if the tag disappears.
- `removeLabel: string` (optional). Override the accessible remove-button name; defaults to the localized remove message plus label.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Disables removal without hiding the tag.
- `tone: StatusTone` (optional; default "neutral"). Semantic status or market role, independent of the selected accent.
- `variant: "soft"|"solid"|"outline"` (optional; default "soft"). Soft fill, solid fill, or outline treatment.
- `size: "sm"|"md"` (optional; default "sm"). Density-aware label size.

Accessibility role: label with optional removal button
Keyboard: Tab, Enter, Space
Tokens: `--sheen-text-caption-size`, `--sheen-color-success-fg`, `--sheen-color-success-subtle`

Do:
- Use visible text as well as color to communicate meaning.

Do not:
- Do not remove a focused tag without moving focus to a surviving control.

Example, Tag example:
```tsx
<Tag label="In review" tone="info" />
```

### TagInput

An ordered free-form tag editor with native multi-value submission and stale-safe async validation.

Category: forms

Props:
- `ref: HTMLDivElement|((element:HTMLDivElement)=>void)` (optional). Native root reference.
- `inputRef: HTMLInputElement|((element:HTMLInputElement)=>void)` (optional). Native editable-input reference.
- `label: string` (required). Required visible field label.
- `name: string` (optional). Native multi-value form name.
- `form: string` (optional). Optional external form ID.
- `value: readonly string[]` (optional). Controlled ordered unique nonempty tag values.
- `defaultValue: readonly string[]` (optional). Initial uncontrolled values restored on uncanceled form reset.
- `onValueChange: (value:readonly string[])=>void` (optional). Receives ordered committed tag values.
- `validate: (candidate:string,context:TagInputValidationContext,signal:AbortSignal)=>TagInputValidationResult|Promise<TagInputValidationResult>` (optional). Optional sync or async candidate validator. It receives accepted values and an AbortSignal; stale completions cannot publish.
- `onValidationError: (error:unknown)=>void` (optional). Receives unexpected validator failures after the retained draft receives a localized error.
- `normalize: (draft:string)=>string` (optional). Synchronous candidate normalization before uniqueness and validation; defaults to trim.
- `placeholder: string` (optional). Editable-input placeholder shown only when no tags exist.
- `description: string` (optional). Supporting text associated with the editor.
- `error: string` (optional). App-owned field error, distinct from candidate validation.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Disables editing, removal, reordering, validation, and form submission.
- `readOnly: boolean` (optional; default false). Keeps values and controls inspectable while rejecting changes.
- `required: boolean` (optional; default false). Requires at least one committed tag in the native form projection.
- `commitKeys: readonly string[]` (optional). Keys that validate and commit the current draft; defaults to Enter and comma.

Accessibility role: labeled text input and native multi-select projection
Keyboard: Enter, Comma, Backspace, Delete, Alt+Arrow keys, Alt+Home, Alt+End
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg`, `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-color-neutral-subtle`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`

Do:
- Use stable exact strings when order and free-form entry both matter.

Do not:
- Do not use TagInput for selection from a controlled taxonomy; use MultiCombobox.

Example, Project labels:
```tsx
<TagInput label="Labels" name="labels" defaultValue={["frontend", "urgent"]} description="Press Enter to add a label." />
```

### Text

Inline text with semantic type roles, accessible muted color, and optional tabular figures.

Category: typography

Props:
- `size: "caption"|"ui-sm"|"ui"|"body"` (optional; default "ui"). Semantic type role, not an arbitrary font size.
- `tone: "default"|"muted"` (optional; default "default"). Primary or AA-gated muted foreground.
- `numeric: boolean` (optional; default false). Enable tabular figures for aligned numeric content.

Accessibility role: inline text
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-font-sans`, `--sheen-font-mono`, `--sheen-color-fg`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`

Do:
- Use visible text as well as color to communicate meaning.

Do not:
- Do not use low-contrast subtle tokens for meaningful text.

Example, Text example:
```tsx
<Text tone="muted" size="caption">Updated recently</Text>
```

### Textarea

A labeled native multiline input with optional frame-batched autosizing.

Category: forms

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required visible label.
- `description: string` (optional). Instructions associated with the textarea.
- `error: string` (optional). App-owned validation message, associated with the invalid textarea.
- `autoResize: boolean` (optional; default false). Measure content after mount and grow or shrink on input, value, width, font, or theme changes. Owns inline block-size while enabled; use min/max-block-size constraints. Rows reserves initial server geometry.

Accessibility role: multiline textbox
Keyboard: Native multiline text editing, Enter inserts a newline, Tab follows native focus order
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-inset`, `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-text-ui-leading`, `--sheen-space-block-xs`

Do:
- Reserve realistic rows on the server. Font-dependent measurement happens after hydration without replacing the control.
- Use max-block-size to cap growth; excess content remains scrollable.

Do not:
- Do not autosubmit on Enter or discard drafts during background refresh.
- Do not animate height while typing or set a competing inline block-size during autosizing.

Example, Growing notes:
```tsx
<Textarea label="Notes" rows={3} autoResize description="Shared with the team." />
```

### ThemeProvider

Owns application theme state, scoped overlays, messages, and root-only persistence.

Category: theming

Props:
- `initialState: ThemeState` (optional). Deterministic initial state; cookie mode requires identical server/client state.
- `defaultMode: Mode|"system"` (optional; default "dark"). Fresh-install preference; system follows the OS only when explicitly selected.
- `defaultTheme: string` (optional; default "obsidian"). Default registered theme ID.
- `defaultAccent: AccentName` (optional; default "jade"). Default independent accent preset.
- `defaultDensity: "compact"|"comfortable"|"spacious"` (optional; default "comfortable"). Default control density.
- `defaultRadius: "sharp"|"soft"|"round"` (optional; default "soft"). Default corner treatment.
- `defaultMotion: "full"|"reduced"` (optional; default "full"). Default motion preference; OS reduced motion still wins.
- `direction: "ltr"|"rtl"` (optional; default "ltr"). Explicit writing direction.
- `locale: string` (optional; default "en-US"). Explicit server/client Intl locale.
- `themes: readonly ThemeMetadata[]` (optional). Registered themes. Load their CSS and configure the same prepaint catalog.
- `storageKey: string` (optional; default "sheen"). Root preference storage key.
- `hydration: "client"|"cookie"` (optional; default "client"). Client prepaint handoff or cookie-authoritative SSR.
- `persist: (state:ThemeState)=>Promise<void>` (optional). Cookie-mode app callback, awaited before accepting preference changes.
- `onPersistenceError: (error:unknown)=>void` (optional). Reports failed storage or cookie persistence.
- `nonce: string` (optional). CSP nonce for generated scope scripts; match the document policy.
- `messages: Partial<Messages>` (optional). Partial translations inheriting English defaults.

Accessibility role: context provider
Keyboard: native behavior

Do:
- Install the theme prepaint script in client hydration mode.

Do not:
- Do not choose initial markup from browser-only state.

Example, Dark application root:
```tsx
<ThemeProvider defaultMode="dark" locale="en-US"><Button>Save</Button></ThemeProvider>
```

### ThemeScope

Overrides theme axes locally, with inherited messages and a contextual overlay target.

Category: theming

Props:
- `controllable: boolean` (optional; default false). Allows scoped setters to modify local overrides only.
- `class: string` (optional). Class for the scope wrapper.
- `messages: Partial<Messages>` (optional). Partial translations layered over the parent scope's messages.
- `theme: string|null` (optional). Local theme ID; omitted inherits and null resets to provider default.
- `mode: Mode|"system"|null` (optional). Local mode; omitted inherits and null resets.
- `accent: AccentName|null` (optional). Local accent preset; never changes root persistence.
- `density: "compact"|"comfortable"|"spacious"|null` (optional). Local density; omitted inherits and null resets.
- `radius: "sharp"|"soft"|"round"|null` (optional). Local corner treatment; omitted inherits and null resets.
- `motion: "full"|"reduced"|null` (optional). Local motion preference; OS reduced motion still wins.
- `direction: "ltr"|"rtl"|null` (optional). Local writing direction; omitted inherits and null resets.
- `locale: string|null` (optional). Local explicit formatting locale; omitted inherits and null resets.

Accessibility role: themed region
Keyboard: native behavior

Do:
- Use independent iframes for full-layout comparisons.

Do not:
- Do not expect scopes to persist preferences.

Example, Light comparison pane:
```tsx
<ThemeScope theme="paper" mode="light" accent="indigo"><Input label="Preview name" /></ThemeScope>
```

### Toast

A notification card with stable action, pending, retry, and dismissal controls.

Category: overlays

Props:
- `notification: ToastNotification` (required). Immutable controller snapshot. Raw errors are never rendered.
- `onAction: ()=>void` (required). Request the owning controller's action. Pending actions cannot be invoked through the button.
- `onDismiss: ()=>void` (required). Request removal without canceling app-owned work.
- `class: string` (optional). Additional card classes.

Accessibility role: group
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`, `--sheen-color-danger-fg`, `--sheen-elevation-overlay`

Do:
- Key cards by notification handle and pass updated snapshots into the existing card.
- Provide safe localized action error text.

Do not:
- Do not use a transient card as the only place essential information or actions can be found.
- Do not mistake the card for a complete queue presenter: announcements, timers, and removal belong to the presenter.

Example, Notification card:
```tsx
const notices = createToaster(); const id = notices.show({ title: "Saved", duration: null }); const notification = notices.notifications()[0];
<>{notification && <Toast notification={notification} onAction={() => { void notices.runAction(id); }} onDismiss={() => { notices.dismiss(id); }} />}</>
```

### Toaster

A scoped, bounded notification queue with live announcements and paused visible-time expiry.

Category: overlays

Props:
- `controller: ToastController` (required). Owner-local notification controller. Mount one presenter for each controller.
- `limit: number` (optional; default 3). Positive maximum number of visible or exiting cards; queued cards do not consume lifetime.
- `label: string` (optional). Accessible region name; defaults to the scoped notifications message.
- `class: string` (optional). Additional region classes.

Accessibility role: region
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Escape
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-duration-fast`, `--sheen-space-block-md`

Do:
- Create and mount a controller inside the appropriate theme scope.
- Keep essential information and actions available without a time limit.

Do not:
- Do not treat dismissal as cancellation of an app-owned request.
- Do not mount multiple presenters for the same controller.

Example, Scoped notifications:
```tsx
const notices = createToaster();
<><Button onClick={() => { notices.show({ title: "Saved", tone: "success" }); }}>Save</Button><Toaster controller={notices} /></>
```

### Tooltip

An action button with hover/focus help and optional shortcut display.

Category: overlays

Props:
- `type: "button"|"submit"|"reset"` (optional; default "button"). Native action, submission, or reset behavior.
- `content: string` (required). Noninteractive supporting text; never a replacement for the trigger's accessible name.
- `shortcut: string|ShortcutAction` (optional). A string displays a hint only; a typed shortcut action also registers the trigger and displays its platform-formatted binding.
- `placement: "top"|"bottom"|"left"|"right"` (optional; default "top"). Preferred side, with viewport collision handling.
- `openDelay: number` (optional; default 500). Hover opening delay in milliseconds; keyboard focus opens immediately.
- `closeDelay: number` (optional; default 100). Pointer departure delay in milliseconds, preserving a hoverable path to the content.
- `variant: NonNullable<"solid"|"soft"|"outline"|"ghost"|"link">` (optional; default "ghost"). Visual treatment; solid accent actions should be rare.
- `tone: NonNullable<"neutral"|"accent"|"danger"|"success">` (optional; default "neutral"). Semantic color role, independent of visual treatment.
- `size: NonNullable<"xs"|"sm"|"md"|"lg">` (optional; default "md"). Density-aware control size.
- `loading: false|true` (optional; default false). Marks pending work and disables activation.

Accessibility role: tooltip
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Escape, Enter, Space
Tokens: `--sheen-button-radius`, `--sheen-control-h-md`, `--sheen-color-accent`, `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-elevation-raised`, `--sheen-duration-fast`

Do:
- Provide a visible label or aria-label on the native trigger.

Do not:
- Do not nest a button inside Tooltip or put interactive controls in its content.

Example, Save hint:
```tsx
<Tooltip content="Save the workspace" shortcut={{ keys: "mod+s", scope: "global", label: "Save workspace", group: "Editing" }} variant="outline">Save</Tooltip>
```

### Tree

A hierarchical treeview with explicit selection, retained expansion state, roving focus, and typeahead.

Category: navigation

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required accessible name for the tree.
- `selectionMode: TreeSelectionMode` (optional; default "single"). Whether items are unselectable, singly selected, or independently selected.
- `selectedValues: readonly string[]` (optional). Controlled stable item values selected by the app.
- `defaultSelectedValues: readonly string[]` (optional). Initially selected values for uncontrolled operation.
- `onSelectionChange: (values:readonly string[])=>void` (optional). Receives requested selection; controlled owners may reject it.
- `expandedValues: readonly string[]` (optional). Controlled stable branch values that expose their child groups.
- `defaultExpandedValues: readonly string[]` (optional). Initially expanded branch values for uncontrolled operation.
- `onExpandedChange: (values:readonly string[])=>void` (optional). Receives requested expansion; controlled owners may reject it.
- `onActivate: (value:string)=>void` (optional). Handles Enter or the default item action without changing selection or focus.

Accessibility role: tree
Keyboard: ArrowDown, ArrowUp, ArrowRight, ArrowLeft, Home, End, Enter, Space, *, typeahead
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-hover`, `--sheen-color-bg-selected`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`, `--sheen-space-inline-sm`

Do:
- Use stable unique values and preserve item ownership while labels or data refresh.
- Keep focus, selection, expansion, and activation as separate states.

Do not:
- Do not use Tree for a flat list or remount it to publish refreshed data.

Example, Workspace tree:
```tsx
<Tree label="Workspace" defaultExpandedValues={["src"]}><TreeItem value="src" label="Source"><TreeItem value="app" label="App" /></TreeItem><TreeItem value="readme" label="README" /></Tree>
```

### TreeItem

A stable leaf or retained branch within a Tree.

Category: navigation

Props:
- `value: string` (required). Required stable identity, unique within the owning tree.
- `label: string` (required). Required visible and accessible item label.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Keeps the item focusable while preventing selection, activation, and expansion.
- `children: JSX.Element` (optional). Nested TreeItems; providing children makes this item an expandable branch.

Accessibility role: treeitem
Keyboard: ArrowDown, ArrowUp, ArrowRight, ArrowLeft, Enter, Space
Tokens: `--sheen-color-fg`, `--sheen-color-bg-hover`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`, `--sheen-space-inline-sm`

Do:
- Keep each value stable across background refresh and reordering.

Do not:
- Do not put unrelated interactive controls inside an item label.

Example, Retained branch:
```tsx
<Tree label="Files"><TreeItem value="src" label="Source"><TreeItem value="index" label="index.ts" /></TreeItem></Tree>
```
